** I’m on the RNC’s Watch List
------------------------------------------------------------

Friends,

This week I joined Mike Slater’s Breitbart radio program (https://www.breitbart.com/radio/2023/09/18/breitbart-news-daily-podcast-ep-391-larry-elder-on-why-televised-presidential-debates-need-to-change/?mc_cid=ca3ce7b4c5&mc_eid=UNIQID) to discuss the RNC’s efforts to stop our growing campaign to restore America. We talked about the issues the RNC doesn’t want to talk about. We challenged them to do the right thing: open the debate to ALL QUALIFYING CANDIDATES.

Mike, like you, understands that the American people deserve a candidate who’s willing to address the issues they care about. They want a choice, not a coronation. Whether the GOP Establishment likes it or not, people are responding to our willingness to address the issues that are tearing our great country apart: the epidemic of fatherlessness, the failure of our education system, and the Soros District Attorney-led crime wave that’s destroying our great cities.

The RNC is hoping we’ll go away. They put our campaign on their “terror watch list.” With your support, we can tell them that their terms are unacceptable, that We the People will not be silenced. Can I count on your support? https://secure.winred.com/elder-for-president-24/rnc-watch-list?mc_cid=ca3ce7b4c5&mc_eid=UNIQID

My campaign is giving the DC establishment that runs the RNC some real heartburn. They want me to go home, but I’ve got news for them: I’m ramping up. I’m touring the country talking to voters like you. I doubled down on my FTC complaint and launched a national ad campaign (https://www.larryelder.com/debate?mc_cid=ca3ce7b4c5&mc_eid=UNIQID) challenging the RNC to abide by its rules for debate qualification.

But I can’t do it alone. I’ve got a powerful political machine doing everything in its power to stop me from standing on that debate stage. That’s why I’m counting on voters like you. We need to get 50,000 unique donors, and we need to be at 3% in two national polls. Given the RNC’s attacks against our campaign, we can’t just meet those numbers. We must exceed them.

With your prayers, votes, and generosity, we can ensure that the American people have a real choice. We can let the RNC know that beating the Harris-Biden regime requires a bold agenda, and with one, we can take our country back.

Will you give $20, $30, or even $50 to help us? A donation of any size takes us one step closer to that debate stage next week. Make your voice heard TODAY! https://secure.winred.com/elder-for-president-24/rnc-watch-list?mc_cid=ca3ce7b4c5&mc_eid=UNIQID

Thanks,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

P.S. We all know that in politics, money talks. I’m not in the pocket of special interests, but I have the support of a citizen movement ready to take our country back. That’s why I’m counting on supporters like you to contribute ANY AMOUNT to show the Washington Elite that We the People won’t be ignored. https://secure.winred.com/elder-for-president-24/rnc-watch-list?mc_cid=ca3ce7b4c5&mc_eid=UNIQID

**What’s happening in Alabama is a disgrace, Peter. ** Republican Attorney General Steve Marshall declared that he has the right to prosecute folks who help pregnant women leave the state to have an abortion. This comes on the heels of Mississippi AG Lynn Fitch attempting to track women who leave the state to receive abortion care. States like Alabama and Mississippi have some of the most restrictive abortion bans in the country, and now they’re trying to trap women and prevent them from leaving in fear of prosecution. **We don’t know how many times we can send out an email and call the state of our country dystopian — but that’s exactly what it is. ** [_**We’re fighting hard to preserve abortion rights everywhere. Here’s a few things you may not know about me. See here why I’d like you on my team and how I’ll thank you when you join!
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=1d5c9afb38cf478baf555977e2c2b028&_e=lW6ts4pHq5Uo8Ugc2vJRuXEzo0piCuxa1G_trzyx0LDS9UoT-k36-8z3cobuYAnkagLprcXUT4cxSGqKzpB67oJxtB6Rttu9UWVLFJT9qeF0AquMg4Mnnct2W_MR8-wDkEKlq_GSXVnEMwgYwdASIS5miBxORYN0QK7X6y-WIE_nUDgjNdDGoSg-iX3wVgr0m5gkdjPFkj97ejCA4bkU_o0P9gsz6hderkI3Ran0Avb6sk-LuSUbTPlVqCwlIsmenqwKT1h22XIy9b-RLeRb0gUy17pTX8nh12W_DmIFTMpjGLzzq0c5cOKar61VCSpiNuwuABp-Lh0oacRaBo2I8aXNjYe9MRMeh34jrQWfKFeR7IzQR4QQqW-ZHo17cOaznDxoryCyjM87_XXQmulmr7nv7n9xVLN6Tkvui5OxRkOXlTT0V2a0rbKOpMaWkUDI)
---
Hi Fellow Conservative,

I've been spending lots of time out on the campaign trail meeting thousands of inspiring Americans, so I'm reaching out to you today with the hope of us getting to know each other better. By the end of this email, after you've heard the story of where I come from, who I am, and why I'm running for President, if you're ready to join my team, I have something special I'd like to offer you. I'll start by telling you where I come from: My mom, a nurse, and dad, a box installer for Nielsen, moved across the Rust Belt before settling down in Florida, where I was born and raised. After I graduated high school, I worked to pay my way through Yale University as the Team Captain of our baseball team, and then went on to graduate from Harvard Law School. In those years, I aspired for a great career, but when I witnessed the horrific events of September 11th, 2001, nothing else mattered to me except volunteering to serve in our military to defend freedom--no matter the cost. I deployed to Iraq with the U.S. Navy as a Judge Advocate General's Corps (JAG) Officer in support of SEAL Team 1, and it was the honor of my life to serve alongside fellow patriots, proudly wearing the cloth of my country as a badge of honor on our uniforms.
---
| [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=1d5c9afb38cf478baf555977e2c2b028&_e=lW6ts4pHq5Uo8Ugc2vJRuXEzo0piCuxa1G_trzyx0LDS9UoT-k36-8z3cobuYAnkagLprcXUT4cxSGqKzpB67oJxtB6Rttu9UWVLFJT9qeF0AquMg4Mnnct2W_MR8-wDkEKlq_GSXVnEMwgYwdASIS5miBxORYN0QK7X6y-WIE_nUDgjNdDGoSg-iX3wVgr0m5gkdjPFkj97ejCA4bkU_o0P9gsz6hderkI3Ran0Avb6sk-LuSUbTPlVqCwlIsmenqwKT1h22XIy9b-RLeRb0gUy17pTX8nh12W_DmIFTMppcbcB5EcULhipJsqZQtv7d5aoYq5_xqYIq1FOxkrcbxAZxjVQ3dFpe_djsvUfMIYwGEmRQf1aNYFMEs8ux1jokQTHOm6L7RjKXm1nJK5Ew63H-0Z_ngfBWxLZ4dQXVVCHS2u712LrAOWWnN7P8kpH)
---
After my time in the service, I felt compelled to continue fighting for what's right and standing up for causes bigger than myself, and I've since been blessed to serve my community as a Congressman and now Governor of Florida. During my term as Governor, our nation was faced with COVID-19, and this pandemic exposed just how much leadership matters. It proved that our nation is in decline because elected leaders have lacked the necessary qualities to stay strong, fight for the people they serve, and chart a different course even if it goes against the grain of public opinion. In Florida, we showed that it can be done--success IS attainable--and I've let my record speak for itself. Two more titles I'm proud to hold are husband to my incredible wife Casey--the best First Lady I believe this state has ever seen--and father to my 6-, 5-, and 3-year-olds. As a father, I'm having to watch the radical Left shove a political agenda down parents' and kids' throats at every turn. They're having to face lies that men can get pregnant and that we should embrace feelings of hate and guilt instead of pride in our country. At this rate, if we don't make a change, we are facing the reality where we become the first generation to leave our children with a worse America than we inherited.
---
| [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=1d5c9afb38cf478baf555977e2c2b028&_e=lW6ts4pHq5Uo8Ugc2vJRuXEzo0piCuxa1G_trzyx0LDS9UoT-k36-8z3cobuYAnkagLprcXUT4cxSGqKzpB67oJxtB6Rttu9UWVLFJT9qeF0AquMg4Mnnct2W_MR8-wDkEKlq_GSXVnEMwgYwdASIS5miBxORYN0QK7X6y-WIE_nUDgjNdDGoSg-iX3wVgr0m5gkdjPFkj97ejCA4bkU_o0P9gsz6hderkI3Ran0Avb6sk-LuSUbTPlVqCwlIsmenqwKT1h22XIy9b-RLeRb0gUy17pTX8nh12W_DmIFTMrLo2v-I8aSVHb0PWbRnCqmaIkugFhIt0e4EZ-At2kbfnvEMSmksl2kDhCWfpUZXMZ9BMWqtnztfJEKVAwf3Tpwf1qbikDw0qOIy9HYlaMTC5d50DoaWe2Y_EaQDIqnpRTjWtDS18WCch4yejz1b6Sh)
---
But, Fellow Conservative, we do not have to accept this decline. It CAN be reversed, and I believe we have a responsibility to step up and do it. This cannot wait another four years. If you share this belief in a better tomorrow with me, I am humbly asking you to join my team. You should know that every dollar counts in this race, and every contribution to my team goes so much farther than you could know. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

subject: President Biden considering big updates to environmental protections -- he needs to hear from you today:
body:
Quick signature needed |
---
| | **Tell President Biden: We Need Stronger Protections!**

The National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) has been a cornerstone of our nation's environmental protections for more than 50 years. The law requires the federal government to assess the environmental impacts of proposed projects prior to their approval -- and allows communities to have a voice in projects that will directly affect them. This is especially important for historically marginalized communities that are heavily impacted by pollution but often weren't consulted or prioritized.

The Trump administration tried to gut this bedrock environmental law. Now we need your help to urge Biden to restore NEPA's protections and modernize NEPA to better incorporate considerations for environmental justice, community engagement, and climate change.

[Tell the Biden-Harris administration to strengthen NEPA regulations, _now_ >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDkegDsG/d3ZEaWJFNUxaR0RlREpyZVdlay9oN2hJVllESGdZekdoaURVaHp1ZkJqbWtLSzFLS1NOMlJmZm01ckZNK1pwbW1ndmxCL3duZTJJa2RSVUhxZU9DTHFaY0FUSUVMdDlqYmt4azJwYlVYRkU9S0/RjNVaVdqNVd0SVhvYWdFOGJrWUt0ZmZ4RDlnNlRobkpjTjRXUDhaVWFPZFRGZlcrOGh0aXJ5bnJhV2dINThlVXAvc3RTd1hIa2ZOTzNSY0tJUHBUL2c9PQS2)
|

**[**TAKE ACTION**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDkegDsG/d3ZEaWJFNUxaR0RlREpyZVdlay9oN2hJVllESGdZekdoaURVaHp1ZkJqbWtLSzFLS1NOMlJmZm01ckZNK1pwbW1ndmxCL3duZTJJa2RSVUhxZU9DTHFaY0FUSUVMdDlqYmt4azJwYlVYRkU9S0/RjNVaVdqNVd0SVhvYWdFOGJrWUt0ZmZ4RDlnNlRobkpjTjRXUDhaVWFPZFRGZlcrOGh0aXJ5bnJhV2dINThlVXAvc3RTd1hIa2ZOTzNSY0tJUHBUL2c9PQS2)**

** **
|
Peter --

During the Trump administration, **extreme MAGA Republicans attempted to gut decades of environmental safeguards set forth in the National Environmental Policy Act,** or NEPA, which has been critical to protecting communities from pollution and dangerous development projects for more than 50 years.

Now, the Biden administration is proposing new standards to correct the remaining damage of the Trump administration's attempts to weaken NEPA and further improve the law to ensure reviews are done as equitably as possible. The proposed standards better incorporate climate change and environmental justice considerations into NEPA reviews and improve overall community engagement.

**This fight is important.** Without strong climate and environmental justice considerations, we run the risk of destroying public lands, fragmenting critical ecosystems, and further polluting the air we breathe and the water we drink, creating irreversible damage in the interest of corporate greed.

That's why we're asking for your help:

[Please, take a moment before next week's deadline to tell the Biden-Harris administration that you support their efforts to strengthen NEPA. Add your name now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDkegDsG/d3ZEaWJFNUxaR0RlREpyZVdlay9oN2hJVllESGdZekdoaURVaHp1ZkJqbWtLSzFLS1NOMlJmZm01ckZNK1pwbW1ndmxCL3duZTJJa2RSVUhxZU9DTHFaY0FUSUVMdDlqYmt4azJwYlVYRkU9S0/RjNVaVdqNVd0SVhvYWdFOGJrWUt0ZmZ4RDlnNlRobkpjTjRXUDhaVWFPZFRGZlcrOGh0aXJ5bnJhV2dINThlVXAvc3RTd1hIa2ZOTzNSY0tJUHBUL2c9PQS2)

Here's why strengthening NEPA is such a big deal, Peter:
* It means requiring environmental impact studies that consider and address climate pollution and environmental justice before federal projects can be approved.
* It means giving people a fair and equitable say in what happens in their communities, engaging them for feedback early in the process.
* It means protecting our air and water and the lives of countless threatened and endangered species on public lands.

Passing the affordable clean energy plan last year was a key step in fighting the climate crisis head-on. Almost $1 billion was allocated to federal agencies to carry out more robust and timely federal environmental review, permitting, and community outreach -- all critical elements also strengthened by the proposed NEPA rule. But fossil fuel executives and unscrupulous developers are trying to block these rules that would mitigate climate pollution and let communities shape what and how projects move forward.

**We need your help to win this fight.** [Tell President Biden to strengthen NEPA, community engagement, and enforce climate and environmental justice considerations for federal projects. Ensuring a sustainable future depends on it: take action right now >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDkegDsG/d3ZEaWJFNUxaR0RlREpyZVdlay9oN2hJVllESGdZekdoaURVaHp1ZkJqbWtLSzFLS1NOMlJmZm01ckZNK1pwbW1ndmxCL3duZTJJa2RSVUhxZU9DTHFaY0FUSUVMdDlqYmt4azJwYlVYRkU9S0/RjNVaVdqNVd0SVhvYWdFOGJrWUt0ZmZ4RDlnNlRobkpjTjRXUDhaVWFPZFRGZlcrOGh0aXJ5bnJhV2dINThlVXAvc3RTd1hIa2ZOTzNSY0tJUHBUL2c9PQS2)

Thank you for taking action to protect our environment and communities, today and for the future.

Onward,

Matthew Davis
Vice President of Federal Policy
League of Conservation Voters |

We have a unique opportunity to restore our Washington State Republican Party to victory, and bring common-sense back to Washington State...

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

name: Will Hurd
subject: Everything You Should Know About The Border
body:
Commonsense takes on immigration and the migrant crisis
---
| | | | | |
---
| _Welcome to The Brief! Common sense takes on current events, national security, and technology and the latest campaign info. It’s designed to make you smarter in less than 5 minutes! If you were forwarded this message, you can get_[ _The Brief here_](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqhNOPmdGabNMJjpJXgTcmHf9Lo/9idsq9KffvV8) _._
---
| Dear Friends, I recently made a trip to the US-Mexican border to highlight the Biden Administration’s utter failure to address the immigration crisis. Every day, drugs and weapons pour into our country along with migrants we have no way to keep track of. In this issue of The Brief, I would like to highlight some important aspects of this crisis that you should be aware of.
---
| | [](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqhNOPmdivJZmi5vEhwXSA6dt3s/yUi2F2_a0qq4)
---
---
| | | | |
### 1\. BORDER VISIT
---

| | | | |
---
| Photo: A still from my recent border ad which is linked below. **Big Picture:** My congressional district spanned more than 800 miles of border and I understand more than anyone how complex and politically challenging this issue is. I recently spent some time down South to highlight what we are doing wrong - and what I think we can do right.
* Watch my new ad about the border crisis [here](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqhNOPmeBG1mD6S19sCbHXvcclw/-43OdvHSfFX9)

**Why This Matters:** This is not just about immigration. Drugs like Fentanyl are pouring over the border and into our kids’ hands as human traffickers risk lives. Securing our border is one of our most important tasks of national security and not something that should be played for political points. We need innovative and common sense solutions for complicated problems.
* As President I will treat Fentanyl like weapons of mass destruction and human smugglers as terrorists.

**Bottom-line:** This is not going to be fixed overnight and will take real resolve and leadership, but the risks are too great to let the status quo continue.
---

| | | | |
### 2\. MIGRANT CRISIS
---

|
---
| Photo: Border patrol agents stopping migrants at the U.S./Mexico border- Carlos Barria/Reuters. **Big Picture:** Global political instability has led to increasing international movement of displaced people, many of whom head for the United States. This is a humanitarian crisis and something we should care deeply about while also understanding that the solution is not unfettered immigration.**Why This Matters:** Many migrants arriving to our borders are seeking asylum and unfortunately many abuse the system.
* This process of treating everyone that comes into the country illegally as an asylum seeker began under the Trump administration but Biden continued it.
* Asylum — a fundamental right enshrined in both international and domestic laws — was designed to offer sanctuary to those genuinely facing persecution, not a shortcut to a good-paying job.

**Bottom-Line** : The migrant crisis and border security are two sides of the same coin. People are coming because they know they can get in. Until we address the underlying failures of our security then we might as well be rolling out a welcome mat for the whole world.
---

|
### 3\. **DEMOCRATIC LEADERS IN REVOLT**
---
|
---
| Photo: Migrant families in Biden t-shirts pleading to be let in at the border- Guillermo Arias/Agence France-Presse Getty Images. **Big Picture** : Long the sole territory of conservative politicians, we are now seeing a wave of dissatisfaction from Democratic leaders around the nation as the immigration crisis arrives at their front doors.
* Blue states have historically been able to throw up their hands about immigration, exclaiming “not our problem” as border states like Texas and Arizona dealt with the brunt. This is changing as the crisis grows ever larger, with thousands of migrants showing up in northern cities needing services.

**Why This Matters** : The Biden Administration is stuck between a rock and a hard place. Leaders in the Democratic strongholds of Boston, Chicago and New York are rightfully frustrated that the Administration is not using its full power to address this issue.
* Though the practice has rightfully come under fire as inhumane, authorities in Southern states have begun bussing and even flying newly arrived migrants to Northern areas. The idea is to highlight the point that states like Texas have been footing the bulk of the bill for years.
* Northern states might be more ideologically welcoming to these newcomers but we are seeing that there is a limit to their hospitality as politicians put pressure on Biden to fix the problem.

**Bottom-Line** : An influx of new arrivals has strained the resources of even the most well-intentioned areas and liberal cities are having to grapple with hard decisions, in some cases for the first time.
* This may be the beginning of a bipartisan effort to tackle immigration and our border, something all Americans should agree needs our immediate attention.

clean_body: Commonsense takes on immigration and the migrant crisis | | | | | | | Welcome to The Brief! Common sense takes on current events, national security, and technology and the latest campaign info. It’s designed to make you smarter in less than 5 minutes! If you were forwarded this message, you can get . | Dear Friends, I recently made a trip to the US-Mexican border to highlight the Biden Administration’s utter failure to address the immigration crisis. Every day, drugs and weapons pour into our country along with migrants we have no way to keep track of. In this issue of The Brief, I would like to highlight some important aspects of this crisis that you should be aware of. | | | | | | | 1\. BORDER VISIT | | | | | | Photo: A still from my recent border ad which is linked below. Big Picture: My congressional district spanned more than 800 miles of border and I understand more than anyone how complex and politically challenging this issue is. I recently spent some time down South to highlight what we are doing wrong - and what I think we can do right. Watch my new ad about the border crisis Why This Matters: This is not just about immigration. Drugs like Fentanyl are pouring over the border and into our kids’ hands as human traffickers risk lives. Securing our border is one of our most important tasks of national security and not something that should be played for political points. We need innovative and common sense solutions for complicated problems. As President I will treat Fentanyl like weapons of mass destruction and human smugglers as terrorists. Bottom-line: This is not going to be fixed overnight and will take real resolve and leadership, but the risks are too great to let the status quo continue. | | | | | 2\. MIGRANT CRISIS | | Photo: Border patrol agents stopping migrants at the U.S./Mexico border- Carlos Barria/Reuters. Big Picture: Global political instability has led to increasing international movement of displaced people, many of whom head for the United States. This is a humanitarian crisis and something we should care deeply about while also understanding that the solution is not unfettered immigration.Why This Matters: Many migrants arriving to our borders are seeking asylum and unfortunately many abuse the system. This process of treating everyone that comes into the country illegally as an asylum seeker began under the Trump administration but Biden continued it. Asylum — a fundamental right enshrined in both international and domestic laws — was designed to offer sanctuary to those genuinely facing persecution, not a shortcut to a good-paying job. Bottom-Line : The migrant crisis and border security are two sides of the same coin. People are coming because they know they can get in. Until we address the underlying failures of our security then we might as well be rolling out a welcome mat for the whole world. | 3\. DEMOCRATIC LEADERS IN REVOLT | | Photo: Migrant families in Biden t-shirts pleading to be let in at the border- Guillermo Arias/Agence France-Presse Getty Images. Big Picture : Long the sole territory of conservative politicians, we are now seeing a wave of dissatisfaction from Democratic leaders around the nation as the immigration crisis arrives at their front doors. Blue states have historically been able to throw up their hands about immigration, exclaiming “not our problem” as border states like Texas and Arizona dealt with the brunt. This is changing as the crisis grows ever larger, with thousands of migrants showing up in northern cities needing services. Why This Matters : The Biden Administration is stuck between a rock and a hard place. Leaders in the Democratic strongholds of Boston, Chicago and New York are rightfully frustrated that the Administration is not using its full power to address this issue. Though the practice has rightfully come under fire as inhumane, authorities in Southern states have begun bussing and even flying newly arrived migrants to Northern areas. The idea is to highlight the point that states like Texas have been footing the bulk of the bill for years. Northern states might be more ideologically welcoming to these newcomers but we are seeing that there is a limit to their hospitality as politicians put pressure on Biden to fix the problem. Bottom-Line : An influx of new arrivals has strained the resources of even the most well-intentioned areas and liberal cities are having to grapple with hard decisions, in some cases for the first time. This may be the beginning of a bipartisan effort to tackle immigration and our border, something all Americans should agree needs our immediate attention. | Thanks for subscribing and reading all the way to the end - I really appreciate you. We cannot quit now!

**[ I'm asking that you take 5 seconds to join the fight today by emailing your legislators by clicking here](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-scltjl-duchtdja-k/),** then **[click here to chip in $15, $25 or $50 to help us mobilize more pro-life supporters to stand against the radicals](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-scltjl-duchtdja-u/). **

name: Governor Ron DeSantis
subject: Hi, Friend. This is my story.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
Our path to victory was further solidified at the first debate. Now I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdqjnd8harbi7sqv6801j49h2gu87lju74fveip0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmap74c9h2bs)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhgq8h5f9jbm1utlb1i9c92euf8qqjqcl5261iq0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmap74c9h2bs)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjqk2ijv67o6ai82i7d7s429hvnao5lt2utmd8uo_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmap74c9h2bs)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmq10ndinllhg41kupvv3jgh2snfub17tuekjhjg_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmap74c9h2bs)
---
But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu4hisndfk6vopleajhjv7181fdno6o2j5kpjvig_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmap74c9h2bs)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---

body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23092%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5tbc2aQgN1X1OpU1WrP6VQ&sysid=1)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23093%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wG5hN8EIG%2faPNVfL8tgqKw&sysid=1) [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23093%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wG5hN8EIG%2faPNVfL8tgqKw&sysid=1)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It’s been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn’t expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it’s all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor’s office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael’s back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael’s_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23094%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ylTiVyEB%2bRLlzIkP%2bIFeYw&sysid=1)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23005%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=056aBa%2b5zB5Pgajl73uItw&sysid=1)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23006%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Y5yskRjibNvwArRUpbvWzg&sysid=1)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23007%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yuI2nFTIp0H72qoGffg7Mg&sysid=1)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23008%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a0xBwTjwuXX%2fuxAdTeZuQg&sysid=1)
_That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23009%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FnRRcedRITgzA9noyH6qhw&sysid=1)
_That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23000%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G91IJalLI5cZtnEj29iAMQ&sysid=1)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

\----------------

clean_body: I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael. I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael. Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas. But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck. That's Michael in the photo. In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve. I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job. Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty. It’s been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years. What I didn’t expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need. I now realize that it’s all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist. Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats. Fear of losing their jobs. I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor’s office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael’s back. But I was wrong. So now Michael’s life is at stake for simply doing his job and we have nobody to turn to except for good hearted strangers like you. Let me give you some more of the details... Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade." The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police. Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man. When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car. The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him. Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired. The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene. My son suffered back and leg injuries. Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck. In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community. There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day. He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others. But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years. Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did? That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died. But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified. And then our whole world was rocked. Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted. Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said: "We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never." I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court. We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense. After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser. They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service. So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds. No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process. Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime." Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael. With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading. Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have. LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son! You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers. Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a I pray you will consider doing so. Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers. My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal. That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today. Sincerely, Margaret Mary Dunn PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind to help Michael will mean so much to my family. \---------------- More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8tukgjokuu1012e344mbr4ikmehkfhgvu6e9pv0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjm6o71c1h2bs)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. * Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;

* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.

These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

---

Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zilqric4scb64v05c88q2apf4vus4jl7ev5hpii0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpjmepr2c1h2bs)

---

---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Governor Ron DeSantis
subject: You deserve to hear from your future President directly
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
The first Republican presidential primary debate marked just the beginning. We fought, and we will continue to fight. We will never back down.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you’re just tuning into the race, I’d like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I’m running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I’m asking for your support.** _**Here’s my story**_ : I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation’s freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That’s why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
But here’s the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They’re telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation’s oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It’s about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob’s fraud.**_
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I’m not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
| | [Chip in to my campaign here](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677494%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NhXqDwfqbvllxFQmBoCW2A&sysid=1)
---
I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage on August 23rd and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Starting on Day One as President of the United States, these are just some of the plans I am promising to you:
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
Friend, together, we will restore sanity to our society, normalcy to our communities, and integrity to our institutions.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
I stood up for the needs of the American people on the debate stage, and I made sure you know that I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. _**[Please, join me in fighting for the future--because freedom is always worth fighting for.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677405%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LrptwAJA32J3aUevC6IVNg&sysid=1 "Please, join me in
fighting for the future—because freedom is always worth fighting
for.")**_ In Freedom,
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677493%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T4SOtrURQ1clo7aKo8NCUQ&sysid=1)
---
Ron DeSantis

---
|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c677406%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YWdlQYuVYM%2f3Q6HhMEt9RA&sysid=1)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives.
