| | **Friend, National Public Lands Day is tomorrow.** It’s the most important day of the year to step up our efforts to protect vulnerable species and the lands they roam. _**And we need you with us.**_ Hunting season is in full swing. And that means bad news for our nation’s wolves and bears. Last year alone, hunters in Montana targeted and killed over 250 wolves. And just a few weeks ago, a mama grizzly was gunned down, leaving her cub orphaned. Now, wolf and bear populations are dwindling. And if this pattern continues, this winter could be the last for many of them. Meanwhile, trophy hunters and special interests want you to think their murderous actions are indispensable. But that's a complete lie. Their actions are driving our nation’s iconic species to the brink. And they’re putting their habitats up for mining, logging, and other destructive practices. All for the sake of profit. We don’t have to let them get away with this. We don’t want to see a world without majestic wolves and iconic grizzly bears. And we know you don’t either, Friend. That’s why Friends of the Earth is fighting back to protect vulnerable wolves, bears, and our planet before the damage is irreversible. That means we’re taking on greedy, destructive corporations. And we’re pressuring lawmakers to take the urgent action we need before countless species are lost forever. **We set a $60,000 goal in service of National Public Lands Day to continue this important work. That’s why I’m personally reaching out to top supporters like you ahead of tomorrow’s crucial deadline. I know that you are as committed to this fight as every member of our core team.[So please: Will you give $27 or more now to help reach our must-hit goal and continue the fight to save vital species and our only Earth?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2003550?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [EARLY PUBLIC LANDS DAY ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2003551?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Preserving Endangered Species Act protections is not just in service of wildlife. This vital legislation is a critical tool to protect life on Earth as we know it. It shields local communities from pollution. It keeps our climate from being driven into utter chaos. And it protects our nation's wildlife from harmful industries like Big Oil and Gas. The attacks on the ESA are proof that it’s working. But if greedy interests succeed in striking it down, it means that these industries can have an easier time exploiting public lands for drilling, fracking, mining, and factory farming.

Friend, without urgent action, **we could lose our greatest tool in the fight to preserve essential ecosystems and protect precious wildlife from extinction.** Because right now, anti-environmental interests are ruthlessly attacking the Endangered Species Act.That’s because the trophy hunting lobby and Big Polluters want even more power. Even if it means **destroying whole ecosystems for profit and pushing struggling species to EXTINCTION.** **And they’ll stop at nothing to get their way. **
That means **we could lose vulnerable creatures like the rare Mexican wolf** , just as their populations are beginning to recover from decades of decimation. **We could lose iconic grizzly bears** , as attacks on their protections are ramping up. **And countless other species could be lost forever -- unless we fight back now.**

clean_body: | | | | | ---|---|--- | | Friend, National Public Lands Day is tomorrow. It’s the most important day of the year to step up our efforts to protect vulnerable species and the lands they roam. And we need you with us. Hunting season is in full swing. And that means bad news for our nation’s wolves and bears. Last year alone, hunters in Montana targeted and killed over 250 wolves. And just a few weeks ago, a mama grizzly was gunned down, leaving her cub orphaned. Now, wolf and bear populations are dwindling. And if this pattern continues, this winter could be the last for many of them. Meanwhile, trophy hunters and special interests want you to think their murderous actions are indispensable. But that's a complete lie. Their actions are driving our nation’s iconic species to the brink. And they’re putting their habitats up for mining, logging, and other destructive practices. All for the sake of profit. We don’t have to let them get away with this. We don’t want to see a world without majestic wolves and iconic grizzly bears. And we know you don’t either, Friend. That’s why Friends of the Earth is fighting back to protect vulnerable wolves, bears, and our planet before the damage is irreversible. That means we’re taking on greedy, destructive corporations. And we’re pressuring lawmakers to take the urgent action we need before countless species are lost forever. We set a $60,000 goal in service of National Public Lands Day to continue this important work. That’s why I’m personally reaching out to top supporters like you ahead of tomorrow’s crucial deadline. I know that you are as committed to this fight as every member of our core team.== | == Preserving Endangered Species Act protections is not just in service of wildlife. This vital legislation is a critical tool to protect life on Earth as we know it. It shields local communities from pollution. It keeps our climate from being driven into utter chaos. And it protects our nation's wildlife from harmful industries like Big Oil and Gas. The attacks on the ESA are proof that it’s working. But if greedy interests succeed in striking it down, it means that these industries can have an easier time exploiting public lands for drilling, fracking, mining, and factory farming. Friend, without urgent action, we could lose our greatest tool in the fight to preserve essential ecosystems and protect precious wildlife from extinction. Because right now, anti-environmental interests are ruthlessly attacking the Endangered Species Act.That’s because the trophy hunting lobby and Big Polluters want even more power. Even if it means destroying whole ecosystems for profit and pushing struggling species to EXTINCTION. And they’ll stop at nothing to get their way. That means we could lose vulnerable creatures like the rare Mexican wolf , just as their populations are beginning to recover from decades of decimation. We could lose iconic grizzly bears , as attacks on their protections are ramping up. And countless other species could be lost forever -- unless we fight back now. Friends of the Earth won’t stand aside while wolves, bears, and the planet suffer these vicious attacks. But we can't win this fight without help from generous supporters like you. We’re counting on you to stand with us with a membership contribution today as we continue fighting to save the ESA and our planet.== == Standing with you, Raena Garcia Senior fossil fuels and lands campaigner, Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687

The first Republican presidential primary debate marked just the beginning. We fought, and we will continue to fight. We will never back down.

Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztc1dthrirp8fsjj4ffrv80tkcaq5rbg65boelg0_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpie8oj1cdh2bs)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi4u6nom0f5ga6ijr4mb0f9h86eog61ipn3lsmno_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpie8oj1cdh2bs)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zjs78qdp3efspfgsdsir20aqns3lnm2mbolgj7s8_rp22sh2s8i66p75cpie8oj1cdh2bs)

But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_

I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
---

| Friend,
What a great first week we've had since we launched the campaign! Our momentum is growing and today we are excited to announce that former Chicago Bear and Chief Justice of the Illinois Supreme Court Bob Thomas has endorsed my campaign for Congress! Chief Justice Thomas shares my vision to lower taxes, bring back jobs, support law enforcement, and improve America's educational system.
"I am endorsing Jerry Evans for US Congress. Jerry is a committed husband, father, teacher, and businessman but he is also a man of integrity, service, and hard work. Jerry has done the important work of garnering support that makes him a formidable candidate in both the Republican Primary and General Election. It's time we had a candidate who can defeat Bill Foster." -Bob Thomas

Gaining Bob's support is just the beginning, and we look forward to continuing to build this coalition and this movement to take back the 11th District.
Bob has seen how hard we have been working to gather support for our campaign. We have been all over this district talking with voters and sharing our vision for the future of the 11th District. However, we still need your help capitalizing on this momentum...
With only eight days left in this fundraising quarter we want to finish our first month strong! clean_body: I hope I made you proud fighting for you at the first GOP debate. Now, I'd like for us to get to know each other better. | | | | | | | | | | Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support. Here 's my story: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1. | Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey. | As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now: Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC; Ranks number one for new business formations; Ranks number one for net in-migration; Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states; Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York; Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report; Has NO state income tax; Has a crime rate at a 50-year low. I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom. | But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud. | Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW. | | | I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage on August 23rd and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Starting on Day One as President of the United States, these are just some of the plans I am promising to you: | | | Friend, together, we will restore sanity to our society, normalcy to our communities, and integrity to our institutions. | I stood up for the needs of the American people on the debate stage, and I made sure you know that I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. "Please, join me in fighting for the future—because freedom is always worth fighting for." In Freedom, | Ron DeSantis | Meet Ron DeSantis | | | | | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI Improvements to our state's infrastructure Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback. Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. **This is disturbing, friend, but we can’t afford to look away. Three young gray wolves were MURDERED near the Colorado-Wyoming border, and bloodthirsty trophy hunters are to blame. These were some of Colorado’s first precious pups born in the wild in more than 80 years! Now the LAST survivors in this vital wolf pack are at extreme risk, and decades of wolf conservation could be DESTROYED!**
Here’s what we’re up against: **When federal protections were slashed for gray wolves, trophy hunters went on an ALL-OUT KILLING SPREE. Hundreds of wolves were violently slaughtered in a matter of days!** But Colorado conservationists have been working tirelessly to protect these majestic creatures and the forests they need to thrive. The problem is: **Colorado’s wolves can be LEGALLY shot and killed as soon as they step over state lines!**
Even worse: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service has been IGNORING science-backed wolf recovery practices! **That means struggling wolf populations have been ABANDONED in pro-hunting states like Wyoming. We can’t stand aside while vulnerable wolves are legally tortured to death with choking snares, violent shootings, ATV chases and even explosives! That's why we urgently need your help to protect gray wolves and the planet they call home – before it’s too late!**
**We're committed to protecting this crucial species and our planet for generations to come and putting a stop to these merciless attacks. But we urgently need to know where our top supporters stand ahead of National Public Lands Day, and we’re still missing 26 responses from your area – including yours! We’re almost out of time, so please, tell us before tomorrow's midnight deadline:**

body:
I hope I made you proud fighting for you at the first GOP debate. Now, I'd like for us to get to know each other better.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f3ed00f311594e50b635c88eb1240a4c&_e=czbN9updmLwbt-LX-2BJpnJEvr1H461coV3iCCelfgsY2ZbbScpp57zT0RMHqnj5VoOyMQ9RVlGWGO_Cei5MIArpSPbkYj4vG3OAujUaGqFVo0pn1hlBOXWq1gsguQ8IwurFmWvI_5ch5MjHGDTjBv_iCR-KbZ-gEQNtcYqL5wfQVRBw2Lrns8lKyar7I-bSaxQXpmNQCMlJFx1N2DM_mWU4e7D_UIdbkmcmQ1Mg9OetOZDRvA2CPuB4uxTIgyf9pMw86f3KfEhPgztZkVvMLkMp8L8BF2J3wLc9bY_NKcLf2Pz_Z1k-OTsvUfA_1nrkOySvk6AaQLFhmFawI8Kqe2ZjqYOWHh0TmxanPBYea9_5gXH3sbY_aHAYlRz1XqrEfgPdHX_5m49f8mN4Zh2aVZ8RN_fcJENyDCVNIj90wz4%3D)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f3ed00f311594e50b635c88eb1240a4c&_e=czbN9updmLwbt-LX-2BJpnJEvr1H461coV3iCCelfgsY2ZbbScpp57zT0RMHqnj5VoOyMQ9RVlGWGO_Cei5MIArpSPbkYj4vG3OAujUaGqFVo0pn1hlBOXWq1gsguQ8IwurFmWvI_5ch5MjHGDTjBv_iCR-KbZ-gEQNtcYqL5wfQVRBw2Lrns8lKyar7I-bSaxQXpmNQCMlJFx1N2DM_mWU4e7D_UIdbkmcmQ1Mg9OetOZDRvA2CPuB4uxTIgyf9pMw86f3KfEhPgztZkVvMLpbYIb0Jgeu4PmsbB-ZxhCpLtXJj0KPXtdbkbHlTm-B2xqI29Kfg_SKcRvsn2wAnFLrno4qKhPYe5GYdiUww5oSTCYCC14yQTui-V61is-_Kd66ukJg25A1SlqOn9ozA2hkRUK2QxT4DbOmXZQ2eOqo%3D)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f3ed00f311594e50b635c88eb1240a4c&_e=czbN9updmLwbt-LX-2BJpnJEvr1H461coV3iCCelfgsY2ZbbScpp57zT0RMHqnj5VoOyMQ9RVlGWGO_Cei5MIArpSPbkYj4vG3OAujUaGqFVo0pn1hlBOXWq1gsguQ8IwurFmWvI_5ch5MjHGDTjBv_iCR-KbZ-gEQNtcYqL5wfQVRBw2Lrns8lKyar7I-bSaxQXpmNQCMlJFx1N2DM_mWU4e7D_UIdbkmcmQ1Mg9OetOZDRvA2CPuB4uxTIgyf9pMw86f3KfEhPgztZkVvMLgt9WCWBPegfLo3pTvOUcTx3KXIX2DXCHsWFnoW2I1RQu7X-c-2KaM6PUDYvN0uMX9KbLLvdl5LX1fnqbPdNoB6OYB6rRScQald0LsxdfwsFfTWdJ_6ACd2R9T_X1GFv2MOkHKYNhxLHFg5ungruQ7o%3D)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f3ed00f311594e50b635c88eb1240a4c&_e=czbN9updmLwbt-LX-2BJpnJEvr1H461coV3iCCelfgsY2ZbbScpp57zT0RMHqnj5VoOyMQ9RVlGWGO_Cei5MIArpSPbkYj4vG3OAujUaGqFVo0pn1hlBOXWq1gsguQ8IwurFmWvI_5ch5MjHGDTjBv_iCR-KbZ-gEQNtcYqL5wfQVRBw2Lrns8lKyar7I-bSaxQXpmNQCMlJFx1N2DM_mWU4e7D_UIdbkmcmQ1Mg9OetOZDRvA2CPuB4uxTIgyf9pMw86f3KfEhPgztZkVvMLifHThfpR9Y-LSJ3ulNVRi6gzCkaCpl3LF9396zTgAYeJg9SK0mbPkzHS1PfHc42tRsZPnwrqb5JE4175wt92vm2ftMXyl6iKSJomSywwuumU-8fNKy_ZziK0AG2d8mn2JuR9V6pmUOaCaI1-trfkp0%3D)
---
But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_
---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f3ed00f311594e50b635c88eb1240a4c&_e=czbN9updmLwbt-LX-2BJpnJEvr1H461coV3iCCelfgsY2ZbbScpp57zT0RMHqnj5VoOyMQ9RVlGWGO_Cei5MIArpSPbkYj4vG3OAujUaGqFVo0pn1hlBOXWq1gsguQ8IwurFmWvI_5ch5MjHGDTjBv_iCR-KbZ-gEQNtcYqL5wfQVRBw2Lrns8lKyar7I-bSaxQXpmNQCMlJFx1N2DM_mWU4e7D_UIdbkmcmQ1Mg9OetOZDRvA2CPuB4uxTIgyf9pMw86f3KfEhPgztZkVvMLshnmHAOZCIpzwAXEdA9TC55qK19eqhDhID4p2Zvhj9qMox79luC4n7zpsjaHkWPq3okcFY0YTYXAR9a5YDsAre5mGDReFvlMcry9FGhTuCkJkctwPV6Qfrw1Y0WXS_VoLCHZuJdHrcN99rNQhB97YU%3D)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Governor Ron DeSantis
subject: I’d like to introduce myself to you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I hope I made you proud fighting for you at the first GOP debate. Now, I'd like for us to get to know each other better.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=147df355e83249cbb82b625568c5de2e&_e=pV1UWBB2Ns60Q-a18LweYU-J-StJMNlLFeR1mAq4J0SDtGvvyJxCLw7w3DEGBKSHgGSkw7TdKP_ZNrvCPe5iDrQvZfBpXh8hwKYLbWtl_-l22YBkoYLB0ISnRZCA8XPUELeKgqlhmJjjY6LgO7XlbOLX_ic3KG6qbTseHULg3cVAzCYl62mDwV-JzlaGxXZJ5X6lLmb5rg_nb0QkG7zf66VypeTMPLIg9Y_hnY21ktRrqLxyRw8d5mg2CsC498BeXBuvemZSqTTqp85V5j_o7plbo-62FQ_wHl9Mjl6OVT9CP01TfoavqIQyvZ8_wKAXcK_tDB-XxQM_obbHbfdF_F_D5XUnfa1kti5li5O8J4eFEhgBYF3yZcCiFLkBtlF8MQCeO2LUJcOd52iFSgxHLKohW8wkcZX8lxI03IhWEvQ%3D)
---
Friend, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=147df355e83249cbb82b625568c5de2e&_e=pV1UWBB2Ns60Q-a18LweYU-J-StJMNlLFeR1mAq4J0SDtGvvyJxCLw7w3DEGBKSHgGSkw7TdKP_ZNrvCPe5iDrQvZfBpXh8hwKYLbWtl_-l22YBkoYLB0ISnRZCA8XPUELeKgqlhmJjjY6LgO7XlbOLX_ic3KG6qbTseHULg3cVAzCYl62mDwV-JzlaGxXZJ5X6lLmb5rg_nb0QkG7zf66VypeTMPLIg9Y_hnY21ktRrqLxyRw8d5mg2CsC498BeXBuvemZSqTTqp85V5j_o7uIQyx31Rkfz6PIjVFDuBYgH5JcnaD0x-2Ogns5815IezUxiYJPOVR1f_a7oFCskMf26g6VQbJjbt1yIVmUMUNCgxtvxoNwNbT0wCpKovaFfRy1FFHZDzMZToB5OEA6BgWZqulvGlTdmudpycM6fqlk%3D)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=147df355e83249cbb82b625568c5de2e&_e=pV1UWBB2Ns60Q-a18LweYU-J-StJMNlLFeR1mAq4J0SDtGvvyJxCLw7w3DEGBKSHgGSkw7TdKP_ZNrvCPe5iDrQvZfBpXh8hwKYLbWtl_-l22YBkoYLB0ISnRZCA8XPUELeKgqlhmJjjY6LgO7XlbOLX_ic3KG6qbTseHULg3cVAzCYl62mDwV-JzlaGxXZJ5X6lLmb5rg_nb0QkG7zf66VypeTMPLIg9Y_hnY21ktRrqLxyRw8d5mg2CsC498BeXBuvemZSqTTqp85V5j_o7vw9wWSF5L-7dMOXjzAJbT9L9mrjiblo_eJsgSkhv-tODdEoBlVvS3fA-jtSroc0G-4Qz17TeCMAEBg-JMUPP9NQR964Vakbx7E5f7Gj51TMZ22WV2_hfXXiYmrr9YcpfyFnf7G_iVd7IIzTLNmIDXo%3D)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=147df355e83249cbb82b625568c5de2e&_e=pV1UWBB2Ns60Q-a18LweYU-J-StJMNlLFeR1mAq4J0SDtGvvyJxCLw7w3DEGBKSHgGSkw7TdKP_ZNrvCPe5iDrQvZfBpXh8hwKYLbWtl_-l22YBkoYLB0ISnRZCA8XPUELeKgqlhmJjjY6LgO7XlbOLX_ic3KG6qbTseHULg3cVAzCYl62mDwV-JzlaGxXZJ5X6lLmb5rg_nb0QkG7zf66VypeTMPLIg9Y_hnY21ktRrqLxyRw8d5mg2CsC498BeXBuvemZSqTTqp85V5j_o7gKv3pyu4oeJkRXNeL1Kg4QZN6bx3WVu6FDGdhIBY5O_K-CNtdVvNBmu4BDDbbvqo46UjdMMUOus1Jf1lhzbCkKeT63y5ycrv9Ps_0XAw1h-87Ul9itMb649_JTR4hoZf-PqCWlUudIMdltlE4Ov60Y%3D)
---
But here's the problem, Friend. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=147df355e83249cbb82b625568c5de2e&_e=pV1UWBB2Ns60Q-a18LweYU-J-StJMNlLFeR1mAq4J0SDtGvvyJxCLw7w3DEGBKSHgGSkw7TdKP_ZNrvCPe5iDrQvZfBpXh8hwKYLbWtl_-l22YBkoYLB0ISnRZCA8XPUELeKgqlhmJjjY6LgO7XlbOLX_ic3KG6qbTseHULg3cVAzCYl62mDwV-JzlaGxXZJ5X6lLmb5rg_nb0QkG7zf66VypeTMPLIg9Y_hnY21ktRrqLxyRw8d5mg2CsC498BeXBuvemZSqTTqp85V5j_o7phP0boaU2th_O_sKBLbFspllXV1CM3PF3c0z_As23hdrS4NqxMDvnrbBcilN3673lV7Ed6Tkm48uv2aTAFge0OWhQOljEO2kISlSqs4lYJTGvGPjOxawhL89Cr5IYpZ_PD9hNI51z0gJ8wunF8FYoc%3D)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
Election Fraud is VOTER SUPRESSION | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/12008cdee7f3/be-brave-do-something-upcoming-events-13544244?e=8763c56857)
---
|
---
|
---
**Let’s make crime ‘bad’ again!**
|
---
_Unless government officials stop denying, deflecting, and distracting from election crimes, voter trust in elections will keep declining and voter suppression will spread_
| [See the Video - Ballot Harvesting in Action ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=4dbacd5f8e&e=8763c56857)
---
|
---
**Why it matters:** The continuing pattern of election crimes in Bridgeport makes clear that no accountability means an erosion of trust in our elections. Worse, no consequences for breaking the law only further embolden illegal activities.
Let's make crime bad again!
|
---
**What happened?**
**√** The Crime - ballot harvesting. A woman identified as Wanda Geter-Pataky, a city employee was caught on security video camera footage making four trips to stuff a ballot drop box in front of City Hall. Wanda was also filmed shouting “We got your back Mayor Ganim” seemingly a boast of her support for the incumbent and a signal that she will do anything to guarantee his victory. √ Can one reasonably conclude the items being stuffed into the ballot drop box were absentee ballots for Mayor Ganim? √ Ganim lost the in-person vote and one the Absentee Ballot vote by 251 ballots. √ Connecticut law requires registered voters to drop off their completed absentee ballots themselves or designate direct family members a caregivers to deliver a ballot on their behalf. [LINK for full statue](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=f94ce1daae&e=8763c56857). The appearance of handfuls of ballots gives one no choice but to assume and fraud and an assault on the integrity of our elections. **Corruption is a team sport**
√ **Law Enforcemen** t - Police Chief Roderick Porter said the leaking of the video was a serious matter and that the department had taken extra measures to ensure the security of the city's video system. Ignoring evidence of criminal acts while trying to make leaking of evidence of the same crime a criminal act a crime? Really?√ **State – Secretary of State Stephanie Thomas** – said she believed it was a matter of a few “bad actors” and an “under-educated electorate”. Governor Lamont warned that we should not jump to conclusions.”√ **City - Clerk Lydia Martinez** was found guilty of fraud according to the SEEC when she was caught illegally filling out absentee ballots. Talk about the fox watching the henhouse! √ **The Bridgeport Democratic Party** has a record of election crime allegations. Several party members have been charged with Absentee Ballot fraud. In 2017 a local council primary was ordered to be run three times due to Absentee Ballot issues. More recently in 2022 a state representative primary involved Absentee Ballot issues and had to be repeated.√ **Corruption thrives on Non-ACTION.** Connecticut's Chief State's Attorney, Patrick J. Griffin, and his office have still not filed those charges recommended by the SEEC from 2019! Charges which included Wanda Geter
|
---
**Key Takeaways – Bridgeport can be your Town**
√ The scope of voter fraud in Connecticut, or anywhere is truly unknowable as fraudsters can only caught with the help of whistleblowers, hidden cameras, and active law enforcement. √ It’s time to put Ballot Drop boxes inside buildings, under human and electronic surveillance, and accessible during normal business hours. Unless we turn on the bright lights of transparency and preserve the chain of custody of every ballot as required by state law this will continue to happen.√ Connecticut now has an easy online solution voters can use to request absentee ballots. This requires legal identification and preserves the chain of custody. All candidates and political operatives should focus on their campaigns and not be trusted with handling ballots applications (or Ballots!!) √ The Governor, Secretary of State, and the Democratic legislature must stop minimizing corruption, blaming others, and pretending it is about politics. It is not. It is about trust in our elections and Bridgeport is one more breach of public trust. When is comes to corruption,**Bridgeport is the gift that keeps on giving!**
|
---
**The final word: Every illegal ballot cancels out a legal ballot**
The facts make clear that election corruption is a team sport. One-party rule clearly lacks checks and balances. Bridgeport is an ongoing saga of corruption that festers when there is no transparency or accountability. From a municipal worker and law enforcement to the clerk’s office and the mayor, the cabal appears well choreographed in covering, distracting, and denying. Thank God for the leaked videos!
Lack of accountability and repeated criminal acts clearly serve to suppress legal voters. All voters, Democrat, Republican, and Unaffiliated must demand action, accountability, and structural changes to stop this ongoing pattern of illegal activities. We must restore ’Trust’ in our elections. Trust is what happens when people know their vote counts.
**Let’s Make Crime ‘Bad’ Again**

|
---

A court date has been set to determine if there will be a new GOMES-GANIM Primary

## Murdoch Leaves Role as Head of Fox
After almost 40 years at the helm, Rupert Murdoch is [stepping down](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNiL7Dmxu8NAlW7p2RMZ3BFcmTo1J2r-v0rnj0xue9D4u08XHFG_Xd7-Jq0uefKjxIZOiDqADnKBlt4iAYCtOGxqQDBG2q_OzWIWwMAfTEwn42Xr0zKxpQBPa6EABKgLQiIPuT4YhkDGax1HbnrDplXCsuZw-c7zVVZb0kx9STiFvbXJrrfe9wbcGzg2c_f0mz_2lXlBqDEkaOG9H4RzWbsnf3dcRayeblFiPvUMFo_G9R63sbGcWo8HzvAQ7kqZhbIvj-zOmFHdjm15dNx_TX7r-f-I3AAD__8L8Xhc) as the head of Fox Corp. (including Fox News) and is giving the reins to his son Lachlan, the current CEO. Murdoch, 92, will move into the new role of Chairman Emeritus. He launched Fox News in 1996, and it continues to dominate the news ratings. Observers say [Lachlan largely follows](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQheGnwZ0tGFhsCorb0O1tU1osDMtE2Fg2u07ePnLqlEc60if9H_f57qnQ-vzvF7Qt1dmHRm-cuekBepAzdNEmREDZoRXa3KTRxsgu2yAlTAJ4UumhH2OEKamRcxO1umk0Y0cWOEhuAISUN6EGHSEYrUWcJjEqI5niGKnVffistLaMqXzXN-5DqEtXbG5tO5j8x8AxcOd5Di3j8-X3SH69PgzcgpE8A3dJDNyB2zUEA1d8yMWv_fLaYw25T_WrX_E8-q0WahSObrdxO6kUOvTIFH8unsov3f4u8RMAAP__sjNeAg) in his father's path regarding news and politics. Actual ownership of the company is more complicated. Murdoch has four children, and they each own a share. Like the show "Succession," Lachlan's siblings could [join together and overrule him](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUheGnwQ5H7lVcCoo0dps2pYNwWcmgOIBr8vaZTdrUf_Od83Gf7ybEsD_ezUa6-jQbW8OT5k5xAA44Q-O0JwLChrSQakAllcJm1cah6q0czbCoxSMu0vjBW9_ZjgYxYhM0dICdAhCIg-hb6cAqKYW73cTYK2R9Ry7UlNvPFPa6ko_f6Um5tWlrol5rPQrDNwYTg-m6rjbTWSmXV2cwLWcJO5XCYNrIBcMrRfpL-TwoV76d2SW78lLpKNyla-d2NSFvZuc-ffGdrsJtygd_SflrtGAwNVm74woxhiJH1nePzYT4i6r_f_QTAAD__7X1aOw) on corporate issues.
## Who Are the Best Employers in Your State?
Forbes Magazine, working with research firm Statista, surveyed 70,000 workers in all 50 states to [determine the best employers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskTGP4yAQhX8N7hzBDCZQuDgpcrfXXmkRM044gYlgsj7_-1NOW5y0aeeb70lP79fH_OFjitvtp8808lpmv3D8pFm6HqAHnKEL40oEhB2NyrgBnXEOu_uIKw3GBGuG8-ClVNJpr7VeCQwotLqLI0hA6QAU4qD0yQRYnDEqWKvO2qHQkkLkUk-_S9z4Tms6yifV01Jyl8Y786MJ_CFgEjDt-35aS71Se2EBU4qNm4DpSo17yo9UDqqtvx59Y8_0snBqd4EXZa01RjvlLAowT84zU80CL57_cAn--LouPj98vG0CL8HHdPQb7S0RM9Wvj0whPl_mN9LKsy70JrNsTBv_B7o6hsceU4rNnIWWt-xj-teZ30_wNwAA__99k4lS) in every state. The survey asked employees whether they'd recommend their company to others and to evaluate their working conditions, compensation packages, potential for development, and more. The final listing is sortable by state and company, and it ranks the 50 best employers in each state. [Click here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskTGP4yAQhX8N7hzBDCZQuDgpcrfXXmkRM044gYlgsj7_-1NOW5y0aeeb70lP79fH_OFjitvtp8808lpmv3D8pFm6HqAHnKEL40oEhB2NyrgBnXEOu_uIKw3GBGuG8-ClVNJpr7VeCQwotLqLI0hA6QAU4qD0yQRYnDEqWKvO2qHQkkLkUk-_S9z4Tms6yifV01Jyl8Y786MJ_CFgEjDt-35aS71Se2EBU4qNm4DpSo17yo9UDqqtvx59Y8_0snBqd4EXZa01RjvlLAowT84zU80CL57_cAn--LouPj98vG0CL8HHdPQb7S0RM9Wvj0whPl_mN9LKsy70JrNsTBv_B7o6hsceU4rNnIWWt-xj-teZ30_wNwAA__99k4lS) to find out which companies make their employees the happiest in your area.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: My life’s work
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep? It wasn't an accident.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)
---
My life’s work has been around one central question: What’s happening to hardworking people in America? What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep — and even rockier and steeper for people of color? Well, here’s the answer: It wasn’t an accident. It was because a series of decisions changed who Washington actually works for. I saw a government that only worked great for those with money and power — for those who could hire armies of lobbyists and lawyers. Corruption, pure and simple. So I got in the fight. I’m fighting for a government that works for families trying to make it payday to payday without getting ripped off — not just giant financial institutions. I’m fighting for a government that works for people trying to fill a prescription — not just giant drug companies. I’m fighting for a government that works for everyone who sees the climate crisis bearing down on us — not just Big Oil. I’m fighting for a government and an economy that works for everyone. That means running for re-election to pass more of the big, bold action we need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, and an end to Washington corruption. [**But none of us can get this done alone. It takes a grassroots movement where we fight side by side. So, if you’re able to, can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to support this movement and power our re-election before our next important quarterly fundraising deadline?](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/479?t=8&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)**

---

---

---
| [DONATE NOW: $50](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/480?t=28&express_lane=true&amount=50&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)
---
| [DONATE NOW: $100](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/480?t=18&express_lane=true&amount=100&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)
---
| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/480?t=20&express_lane=true&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)
---

---
Here’s how I see this: We need to keep making bold change as a country. Not a nibble here, a piece over there. Big, systemic change. The kind of change that will make this government reflect the will of the people. We’ve seen what we can accomplish when the American people elect champions for working families. We overcame swarms of financial industry lobbyists to create the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which has put $16 billion back in the pockets of Americans who’ve been cheated. We beat Big Pharma by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices for the first time. We passed the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change, which is set to lower carbon emissions by 40 percent. I’ll be the first to say there’s more we’ve got to do, including codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law. If we can come together and expand our Senate majority, and if we can take back the House, we can make more transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth, but as an unapologetic Democratic majority. So I’m running for re-election to stay in the fight. [**If you’re in a place to make a contribution, can you donate $28 or whatever you can to help build our grassroots movement, win our re-election campaign, and build a government that works for working people? Your support before the September fundraising deadline would be a huge help.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/479?t=14&akid=71%2E4032634%2Ezybv7s)** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

body:

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0p0e80914kht8vvl2o4sgcqrud2qcqvu6c3mh3g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6aor6c3h2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvihikhtfldapr3tgdlq9l85irj1t7gkfhc6h04g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6aor6c3h2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University

subject: Chaos in Congress
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
If you’ve been reading the news this week, you know exactly what I am talking about: the utter failure of House Republicans to do the fundamentals of their job—to pass legislation to fund the government.
Twice this week, House Republicans failed to get enough votes from their members to begin debate on the floor on the bill to fund the military. (This is called passing “the Rule.”) Like many of my colleagues, I had not seen this happen before this year. And that’s because it almost never happens. Since 1995, the House has failed to pass a rule only eleven times. Two of them were this week. Three of them were this year.
It has been a week of confusion, chaos, and frustration, as serious members worry about the possibility of a government shutdown and what it will mean for people across the country. With 8 days until the federal government runs out of funds, House Republicans are wasting time and fighting each other instead of working with Democrats to pass legislation to prevent a government shutdown that would hurt our fellow Americans, our economy, and our national security.
House Republicans are all alone on this. House Democrats and the Democrats and Republicans in the Senate are ready to follow the bipartisan agreement we made (and passed into law) earlier this year. But some House Republicans are demanding drastic cuts to programs that American families count on for public safety, health care, education, food, and more while at the same time insisting on extreme, deeply divisive policy proposals. Even Senate Republicans are opposed to the House Republicans’ extreme demands.
From banning abortion nationwide to impeaching the President, several House members are making extreme demands and withholding their votes until they are met, all the while threatening to remove the Speaker of the House if he does not accede. And they do not appear to have a leader who can stop the chaos.
It doesn’t have to be this way. It wasn’t this way in the last two Congresses, when Democrats controlled the House. We took seriously our obligations to do the work we were sent to Washington to do, to ensure the continued, effective operation of the government, and to put people over politics.
The support of #TeamLizzie made that possible in 2018 when we flipped this seat from red to blue and with it control of the House. Now, we have to hold on here and help take back the House. You can help do that by making a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230922?refcode=folf230922]
Together, we can do anything,

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrqdpq2h4q9q6j9sjqgtrddprcmchdhmgcoineug_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6eob4cdh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsropeqomr95abu2c0d600nk6ehmnta79n95g0mg_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6eob4cdh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfc6b59786pb7fm5gcokhtt5qpkkju4e7lbabdkg_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6eob4cdh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj7cujlbl130q68u8tj7v3pill3r9si6i0fv73v8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c5g6eob4cdh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

---
---

subject: A busy August on the road

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4013%2E5257348%2EN79WGk ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, it was a
busy August on the road!

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20230922_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4013%2E5257348%2EN79WGk ]Read through our latest campaign update below, and if you can, please
chip in a few bucks to keep us on the road!

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=sep2023_abs_em.d0Aj_h&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20230922_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=1005&akid=4013%2E5257348%2EN79WGk ]EXPRESS DONATE
