clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Rokita Becomes Second Consecutive Republican AG Charged With Disciplinary Misconduct On Monday, the Indiana Supreme Court Disciplinary Commission filed a against Republican Attorney General Todd Rokita. The complaint came after Rokita was interviewed on extreme Fox News, and he made comments about a lawsuit involving a ten year old rape victim who received abortion care in Indiana. Indiana law prohibits attorneys involved in investigations from making public comments that may affect judicial proceedings. Rokita is the second consecutive Indiana Republican Attorney General to be charged with misconduct. Before him, AG Curtis Hill was found to have committed multiple incidents of sexual misconduct. Next year, we can retire Rokita. Green Energy Jobs Growing in Every State Thanks to Democratic Investments This week, a new report was released showing a employed in the clean energy industry. In 2022, there were more than 88,400 Indiana jobs related to clean energy, a 3.7 percent increase from 2021. This news comes on the heels of President Biden and Democrats in Congress passing the Inflation Reduction Act in August of last year, which led to significant investments in Indiana clean energy projects. The Inflation Reduction Act and other policies under President Biden will continue to create record investment in communities across the state in the industries of the future. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week, State Rep. Maureen Bauer (South Bend) was article for her leadership on HEA 1219, legislation providing resources for firefighters and retired firefighters to get tested for dangerous chemicals they may have been exposed to in the line of duty. Rep. Bauer drafted the legislation after three firefighters in South Bend passed away from brain cancer related to occupational hazards. Thanks to Rep. Bauer’s commitment to the health of Hoosiers, HEA 1219 passed and went into effect in July. Indiana firefighters now have better access to potentially lifesaving blood tests, and Rep. Bauer’s leadership looks to inspire policy action across the nation. ** Become a Delegate to the 2024 State and National Conventions ****** The Indiana Democratic Party is holding a across the state for Hoosier Democrats interested in becoming delegates to the national convention. We would love to see you in Chicago next summer as part of the delegation that will nominate the President and approve our party’s national platform. This is a huge win, but there is still work to be done!
#

In a *_huge_ * reversal of Trump-era promises to Big Oil, President Biden has canceled massive oil drilling projects. Not only that, he also announced the American Climate Corps, a top priority for the climate justice movement. **These are BIG WINS for not only our movement but the future of our planet.**

[**At our Let Us Worship revival last month, there was no violence, no rioting, no destruction.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=8011ee2071b64cdd8fc1f386d9649bb6&_e=--ut3GjBU3dAJDMAnO_NFobbuvhEwdQGmLvM3nZTHyq4H-gYj5g8vbHTv_9nbpZ0HEbF8tD91_u6_TvmtHZJN2iWNPLKbKQ6ZztEK1kj-sG34IXA5qC98O-DopjGXGy2TbjVMVOJjXujq3RFyQ--WKFIsMYxnmwvGPziMOtC9LSsZ88X3llWsyj5RaStPsuvt-ohpih5l57j5dtAxTVWyRYJ_5niqdaBCNRXjgmlt7xAT-Bwz2yWUz6vzq20VcswlkxnOfSpW5jteKjGJy57dKpXPkAKn1qMC3GA3TQcHDi4IsozhRXyDJgWoErUksbP) It was a simple gathering of Believers peacefully praising and worshiping God. We need to come together to keep Bob fighting for Pennsylvanians in the Senate.

Derek, Josh Shapiro here. Mitch McConnell’s hand-picked candidate just launched his campaign for Pennsylvania’s Senate seat. I know a thing or two about winning tough races in Pennsylvania (to start with, you should actually live here.) In 2022, I ran against a dangerous extremist who promised to eliminate women’s right to choose, endanger our democracy, and rip away our fundamental freedoms. But because of folks like you, I won that race by a historic margin. But that dangerous extremism hasn’t gone away — and we’re seeing it yet again in Pennsylvania’s Senate race. [_**This is urgent: we need to come together to keep my good friend Bob Casey fighting for Pennsylvanians in the Senate. name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Breaking news in the PA Senate race
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
We need to come together to keep Bob fighting for Pennsylvanians in the Senate.
Peter, Josh Shapiro here.
Mitch McConnell’s hand-picked candidate just launched his campaign for Pennsylvania’s Senate seat.
I know a thing or two about winning tough races in Pennsylvania (to start with, you should actually live here.) In 2022, I ran against a dangerous extremist who promised to eliminate women’s right to choose, endanger our democracy, and rip away our fundamental freedoms.
But because of folks like you, I won that race by a historic margin. But that dangerous extremism hasn’t gone away — and we’re seeing it yet again in Pennsylvania’s Senate race.
**[This is urgent: we need to come together to keep my good friend Bob Casey fighting for Pennsylvanians in the Senate. Extremist Republicans are already targeting this seat, and we need to make sure Bob has the resources to counter their outside money and attacks.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230922-2?refcode=em20230922-2&refcode2=721_552475_d46pKE&akid=721%2E552475%2Ed46pKE)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230922-2?refcode=em20230922-2&refcode2=721_552475_d46pKE&akid=721%2E552475%2Ed46pKE)**
Here’s why Bob needs our support:
More than **$381 million** was spent on Pennsylvania’s Senate race in 2022. Now that their chosen candidate is in the race and with the presidential race at the top of the ticket, extremist Republicans are going to spend even more to try to finish the job in 2024._In fact, I wouldn’t be surprised if PA saw more political spending than any other state this cycle._
Thanks to grassroots supporters like you being by our side every step of the way, John Fetterman and I were able to counter GOP attacks and defend our freedoms in PA last year.
**We need to show Bob Casey that same level of support in his re-election fight.**
**[Bob has always had my back-- now, we need to have his. Can you chip in $5 to his campaign right away to help him and his team respond to this new opponent? Senate control could come down to what happens here in PA.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230922-2?refcode=em20230922-2&refcode2=721_552475_d46pKE&akid=721%2E552475%2Ed46pKE)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230922-2?refcode=em20230922-2&refcode2=721_552475_d46pKE&akid=721%2E552475%2Ed46pKE)**
Thanks,
Governor Josh Shapiro

Hey friend, this is Zoë Kleinfeld, Lateefah Simon’s campaign manager.
I just finished a meeting with the whole team to plan out the next 8 days before our end-of-quarter deadline. As the campaign manager, it’s my job to make sure our team is on track to meet all of the goals we set. We don’t set these goals arbitrarily — we intentionally set these goals because it allows us to fully fund our outreach plans and campaign strategy.
To be blunt, we’re a little behind where we would like to be at this point in the month. [**Friend, will you make a contribution right now so we can close our fundraising gap and reach our goal of $6,000 in online contributions before September 30?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230922?amount=10&refcode=em20230922-1&refcode2=124_1163_Ns25kd&akid=124%2E1163%2ENs25kd)

Peter, Overnight, Republican legislators passed their long-overdue state budget. **While there are many problems with this budget, it fulfills my promise to enact Medicaid Expansion.** Securing health insurance for 600,000 more North Carolinians will bring more mental health and substance use disorder treatment, help for desperate rural hospitals, and billions of dollars into our economy. It is a life-saving, monumental decision for our state. Make no mistake, overall this is a bad budget that seriously shortchanges our schools, prioritizes power grabs, keeps shady backroom deals secret, and blatantly violates the constitution. Many of its provisions will face legal action. However, we must recognize that this irresponsible legislature’s decade of refusal to expand Medicaid caused life-and-death situations for so many North Carolinians and threatened the very existence of numerous rural hospitals. **I will not allow people who are crying out for help to wait any longer. Medicaid Expansion must be enacted now, and I’m directing our Department of Health and Human Services to begin the process today.** This budget will become law without my signature. Peter, I won’t stop fighting for the schools, public servants, and taxpaying North Carolinians shortchanged by this backroom budget deal. Not content to have America’s economic standing in the world downgraded once over the debt limit bill, Scott Perry’s Chaos Caucus is determined to do it again by shutting down the government on September 30.

If they get their way, they will cost Americans more billions in inflated borrowing costs, send millions of clean-energy jobs to China, and raise unemployment when parents can’t afford child care while they work.

**I will vote and aggressively advocate to help make our government work for all, cut inflation, champion clean-energy jobs here in Central PA, strengthen local small businesses and economic development, and give __ALL__ parents a fighting chance at a decent life for themselves and their children.**

This week, House Republicans couldn’t even debate – much less pass – a bill to fund our military. Like the notorious Tommy Tuberville (R-Alabama) in the Senate, they’re endangering national security, and they don’t care. They’re determined to force their culture wars on every farm, village, town, and city in the land no matter how many US soldiers it endangers, no matter how many innocent children it hurts, no matter how many families it disrupts, whether the American people like it or not.

**Earth to Perry: The American people – and the people of our 10th district – are entitled to the government they want and are willing to pay for.** Your tiny band of extremists should not take America hostage for your radical MAGA agenda. Americans overwhelmingly oppose your irresponsible actions, and your job is to do the will of the American people, not obstruct it.

Fellow American,

_**Time is limited so I'll keep this short:**_ this is the last weekend before the next Presidential Debate in California.

clean_body: | | | | Earlier this month, the Biden administration named the 10 prescription drugs for which it will seek to negotiate lower prices on behalf of Medicare. This could help millions of seniors afford medication for diabetes, heart disease, blood cancer, or arthritis. This action was possible because of the historic legislation Democrats passed last year that took on Big Pharma and allowed Medicare to negotiate drug prices – legislation that David Schweikert voted against. It's simple: I'll fight to keep lowering prescription drug prices to help seniors and my opponent won't. = = Our seniors are struggling to afford critical medications. Out-of-pocket costs for prescriptions can climb as high as $40,000 per year for some Medicare patients. As a result, some seniors are rationing their meds, delaying refills, or forgoing treatment altogether. That's outrageous, Peter. It's also preventable. No one should be taken for a ride by greedy pharma corporations. They should have easy access to the medications they need to live long and happy lives. Yet David Schweikert would have chosen to keep the status quo. He voted to keep prices high for Arizona seniors and betrayed his constituents. I am building a grassroots movement to take on David Schweikert and flip AZ-01 from red to blue. We need a member of Congress who will stand up for their constituents and not bend over backwards to protect major pharmaceutical companies. Our movement is growing because of folks just like you – but we can't afford to take our foot off the gas. = Conor | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for and authorized by Conor for AZ. |

name: Cori Bush
subject: Rashida and I are defending the right to protest.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
We’re speaking out about the attacks on #StopCopCity activists. | |
---
Peter, Have you heard about the crackdown on #StopCopCity activists in Georgia? It’s outrageous, and relevant for all of our movements. Many community members oppose plans to build a massive complex just outside of Atlanta, where police would practice suppressing protests and using military tactics to target civilians. Activists have been calling this oppressive plan “Cop City.” As part of a dangerous campaign to silence dissent and criminalize protest, Georgia officials have charged over 100 nonviolent activists with domestic terrorism and racketeering. Recently, a SWAT team violently arrested people who’d been acting within their rights to coordinate a bail fund in support of #StopCopCity protesters. **I’ve been joining with my sister in service, Rep. Rashida Tlaib, to speak out about these unacceptable violations of constitutional rights.** We’re asking other national leaders to join us in defending activists’ right to protest our government. **We’re calling for accountability:** The Department of Justice must investigate the police murder of forest defender Tortuguita, the cover-up of their killing, and the deprivation of protesters’ civil rights. **Rashida and I understand how urgently we must protect our First Amendment rights to free speech and assembly.** We were activists before serving in Congress, and we have experienced police violence against protesters marching in defense of Black lives in Ferguson and Detroit. **We’re also pushing for policy solutions to fix our broken criminal legal system and keep our communities truly safe -- which includes safety from police violence.** We’ve championed legislation to invest in the basic needs of our communities, fund public health alternatives to policing, reduce prison and jail populations, end solitary confinement, support families harmed by police violence, decriminalize drugs, expunge past drug convictions, expand our civil rights laws, and more. clean_body: We’re speaking out about the attacks on #StopCopCity activists. | | Peter, Have you heard about the crackdown on #StopCopCity activists in Georgia? It’s outrageous, and relevant for all of our movements. Many community members oppose plans to build a massive complex just outside of Atlanta, where police would practice suppressing protests and using military tactics to target civilians. Activists have been calling this oppressive plan “Cop City.” As part of a dangerous campaign to silence dissent and criminalize protest, Georgia officials have charged over 100 nonviolent activists with domestic terrorism and racketeering. Recently, a SWAT team violently arrested people who’d been acting within their rights to coordinate a bail fund in support of #StopCopCity protesters. I’ve been joining with my sister in service, Rep. Rashida Tlaib, to speak out about these unacceptable violations of constitutional rights. We’re asking other national leaders to join us in defending activists’ right to protest our government. We’re calling for accountability: The Department of Justice must investigate the police murder of forest defender Tortuguita, the cover-up of their killing, and the deprivation of protesters’ civil rights. Rashida and I understand how urgently we must protect our First Amendment rights to free speech and assembly. We were activists before serving in Congress, and we have experienced police violence against protesters marching in defense of Black lives in Ferguson and Detroit. We’re also pushing for policy solutions to fix our broken criminal legal system and keep our communities truly safe -- which includes safety from police violence. We’ve championed legislation to invest in the basic needs of our communities, fund public health alternatives to policing, reduce prison and jail populations, end solitary confinement, support families harmed by police violence, decriminalize drugs, expunge past drug convictions, expand our civil rights laws, and more. | Peter,

When I first ran for Congress in 2018 – flipping my seat blue for the first time in 50 years – I often spoke of a letter my parents wrote to my sisters and me to celebrate the year 2000, a new millennium.

In it, they wrote out lessons for their daughters. One of which has been a driving message throughout my life – _**“There is no greater vocation than service to your country.”**_ These words have been foundational throughout my life and inform how I approach my work in Congress every single day. At CIA, I served our country by collecting intelligence to keep Americans safe. And in Congress, I do it by working for the Virginians I serve and getting things done — not grandstanding.

_**As one of the most bipartisan Members of Congress, I know we deliver for our community when we work together.**_ With that philosophy in mind, I helped negotiate and pass the bipartisan infrastructure law, which is already delivering smart investments to repair our roads, fix our bridges, protect our energy grid, and expand broadband internet access.

I’ve also led the bipartisan charge to ban stock trading by Members of Congress and their spouses – removing even the perception of possible impropriety and reinforcing the standard that representatives serve the people, not their own stock portfolios.

[_**With so many important elections just around the corner, I can’t wait to see what more we can accomplish together. To continue my work, I need your support. clean_body: As one of the most bipartisan Members of Congress, I know we deliver for our community when we work together. | = | Peter, When I first ran for Congress in 2018 – flipping my seat blue for the first time in 50 years – I often spoke of a letter my parents wrote to my sisters and me to celebrate the year 2000, a new millennium. In it, they wrote out lessons for their daughters. One of which has been a driving message throughout my life – “There is no greater vocation than service to your country.” These words have been foundational throughout my life and inform how I approach my work in Congress every single day. At CIA, I served our country by collecting intelligence to keep Americans safe. And in Congress, I do it by working for the Virginians I serve and getting things done — not grandstanding. As one of the most bipartisan Members of Congress, I know we deliver for our community when we work together. With that philosophy in mind, I helped negotiate and pass the bipartisan infrastructure law, which is already delivering smart investments to repair our roads, fix our bridges, protect our energy grid, and expand broadband internet access. I’ve also led the bipartisan charge to ban stock trading by Members of Congress and their spouses – removing even the perception of possible impropriety and reinforcing the standard that representatives serve the people, not their own stock portfolios. = | = With gratitude, Abigail Spanberger * | | = Paid for by Spanberger for Congress Spanberger for Congress P.O. name: Angela (personal)
subject: I’m sorry for talking your ear off, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
I apologize in advance for talking your ear off,
Peter; I’ve got a lot to say
today!

After such an exciting summer, I’ve been thinking back on the experiences
that shaped me and sent me down this path of public service nearly 30
years ago. I’ve written down some of those experiences (and included some
cute throwbacks for you to enjoy, too!).

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1011&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Of course, if you’re in a hurry, you can go ahead and chip in $25 to
make sure we crush this End-of-Quarter FEC goal next week!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1012&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Donate

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6103?t=1006&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Angela as [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6103?t=1007&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Angela with her
a baby great-grandmother

You’ve probably heard me talk about my great-grandmother Maebell James – a
relentlessly strong, compassionate woman who was a guiding North Star to
our family.

She embodied self-worth, determination, and respect, and she made sure to
instill those traits in her kids and grandkids, too. I believe every young
person deserves a champion like her, who gives them the tools they need to
succeed.

As County Executive, I’ve increased funding for public schools, improved
support and guidance for students of all ages, expanded and funded
after-school programs, and helped establish and expand summer job programs
to help teens gain confidence and work experience.

I’m proud to be a champion for young Marylanders, and I’ll continue that
work in the Senate. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1013&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Would you please consider contributing $25 to my
campaign to help me go farther and do better for the next generation?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1014&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Donate

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6103?t=1008&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Angela with mom & [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6103?t=1009&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Angela with
dad mom & dad

I learned by my great-grandmother and my parents’ example that if
something’s broken, you don’t wait around for someone else to fix it, you
go get your toolbox. Those values guided me towards public service a whole
26 years ago, and I’ve never once looked back.

When I wanted to create a safer neighborhood for my daughter, I ran for
State’s Attorney. When I wanted to find solutions to prevent individuals
from entering the justice system in the first place, I ran for County
Executive.

Now, I’m running for Senate because there’s a lot to fix, and too many
leaders who want things to stay broken: our healthcare, economy,
infrastructure, environment, education, and a whole lot more.

Working families deserve a system that works for them – [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1015&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]so please, will
you chip in $25 to start laying a foundation for a safer, healthier, and
more prosperous future?

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/6104?t=1016&amount=25&akid=497%2E52803%2EX1OtVt ]Donate

I know I’ve given you a whole lot to think about here,
Peter, so thank you for reading
it all the way through. And most of all, thank you for being a part of
this groundbreaking movement.

Have a wonderful weekend,

Angela

Peter, It was only a matter of time before Republicans used the same playbook they used against me on someone else — after all, it worked the first time. A few weeks ago, intimate details of Susanna Gibson’s private life were shared in _The Washington Post_ without her consent, and without good reason. **What women (or anyone) do with their bodies in their private time is not a matter of public interest.** By circulating images taken without my consent, or finding and publicizing videos that were meant to disappear, as in Susanna’s case, Republican operatives and the publications that enable them are trying to shame and humiliate women into never running for office. Peter,

It’s officially been one week since United Auto Workers (UAW) launched
their historic strike against the Big Three automakers in Detroit: GM,
Ford, and Stellantis. Justice Democrats and our candidates have proudly
stood in solidarity with these workers since Day 1.

Ayanna Pressley turned out for a UAW solidarity event on Capitol Hill and
has been actively sharing ways for others to show their support across
social media.

Rashida Tlaib joined Bernie Sanders in speaking at a UAW rally in Detroit
and joined workers on the Ford picket line in Wayne, Michigan last week.

Summer Lee spoke out against corporate greed and stood in solidarity with
the 140,000 striking UAW workers on the floor of the U.S. House.

Plus, AOC and Cori Bush are coming together for a solidarity rally in St.
Louis this Sunday!

From the picket lines to the halls of Congress, Justice Democrats are
making it loud and clear: UAW workers deserve better pay, benefits, and
working conditions, and we have their backs until the Big Three deliver!

This has been a historic year for the U.S. labor movement as workers
across different industries have come together to unionize and go on
strike in order to say enough is enough — and your support of our work to
elect progressive, working class candidates has made all the difference.

Friend, This week, President Biden met with Israel’s far-right Prime Minister Netanyahu, who’s escalating apartheid against the Palestinian people. **We cannot normalize the Israeli government’s war crimes against Palestinians. Not only that, he doesn't even live in Pennsylvania -- he's been commuting from CONNECTICUT to prepare for this campaign!! Bob Casey is teaming up with John in the Senate to fight for Pennsylvania's hard working people. That's why Mitch McConnell and the national GOP are targeting Pennsylvania for millions in dark money spending. They're hoping that their super PAC money + McCormick's million$ will be able to pay to flip the Senate red. 🔴 We'll only be able to stop them with your help -- we need a ton of grassroots support to protect our narrow Senate majority. Thank you for your support, Derek. We couldn't do it without you. More soon, Team Fetterman | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

Derek,
If we’re going to share Adam’s message and elect him to the U.S. Senate, we’ll need to start hitting the ground — literally. Let us explain.
Campaigns win and lose based on how many people you can turn out to vote. California is no stranger to close races — last year, Republicans won one of the state’s congressional races by just **_500 votes._**
Adam recognizes the importance of organizing and reaching voters in every zip code, which is why we’re making early investments in our organizing team.
**One of the best ways to grow our organizing efforts is through yard signs like these:**

This week, our Armenian friends living in the Artsakh region faced a deadly military attack by the nation of Azerbaijan. Armenia is a longtime ally of the Valley, California, and our nation. The primarily Muslim nation of Azerbaijan is currently holding the Armenian people in Artsakh hostage and has blockaded them for months from receiving food or medicine.

Joe Biden has chosen to stand with the oil-rich Azerbaijan government. In the past, Joe Biden has sided with the Turkish government and those who have historically persecuted and committed genocide against the Armenian people.

_**Let me make my position 100% clear. I stand with the Armenian people, those living in Artsakh currently under attack, and will always support religious liberty and self-determination. It is important that United States leaders call out Joe Biden and his failure to criticize the Azerbaijan government.**_

I will not hesitate to take bold stands for justice and freedom. That's what we desperately need with a new generation of leadership here in the Central Valley. | | Another shutdown is looming. The end of the month marks the end of the fiscal year. If we can’t [get our act together](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0d504e4a97642a6b5826452753b79fe&_e=A-2t---pKNVYLFq8ifK69HuEFUSORI8jts1hE2taRIxCBGuLY41Y1Qx0tm7qOdbP_MykYido5P97lfM0chd0lo4J97nLatxcmqxJGFNvJaQzDpUMR9dWS050St003WBNyAfJf3CfsMQ3WRnTn8JPA__mM-JfoOdRbeUJXS4x3RKaXwPGoYN3dO5_SZauAtEfhzCE5u5Da8rAq5xkda93RPZDx_9xU_QDeXZjJuLI5PWSXJkM_PseVlOc4HwSJY7bpfryspvPOD7sDpwWqKpf8xVXgZIuwPc1_qlSwqGDpQw%3D) by then, we all know what happens: Hardworking Americans [foot the bill](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0d504e4a97642a6b5826452753b79fe&_e=A-2t---pKNVYLFq8ifK69NHneYGW-AAla_IgN3bRVHRS8lZDv04t-dF_9gMd9fmYsaRAIonnD-rH1DyAq3MOs9P_1f4A0gS-bWuddxgpEAaCuy2Pag-dLefKSRVJo_uGzvMFFa2-GJxWCnGLR58n9pUrkZ68suR_eO8jRHon7mFyfwv4veBe78Be0NVEsK6KTGIj36KZDcWUg8DBVxYdzo1O12xMyUAwLEg-NjZ75a4paiaoj0eh9t3Wrvipb5GKwC7Swevd6IbCWUFdqQ0riqAY8zInoMw8wEsG40Ewgz5jx17_UihO_FB1uqsCKq1ryRReV-vyth7HowMKUsCUhQ%3D%3D) for a dysfunctional circus they have nothing to do with. To make matters worse, we were told to [go home](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0d504e4a97642a6b5826452753b79fe&_e=A-2t---pKNVYLFq8ifK69HuEFUSORI8jts1hE2taRIycBVrUfgdWqpDwZHad6fQVoqQ5UEXx694F3Vnb2iwtbq9jePJ4mevN7o23npuJ_4Y-wRY97JgtyaUB5W5cHaxGFGkIdpja7Yu7alJEj2YFmfZdqlEMkbAaZgK3cveZB155ORZLP147QbTChWdXW5WfzEN-BYRh1e-Afe3iZV2LkvexWMmPozVrrLcETjfjRBiMrlv79wUNUj1o__vTPAyJw8V2BTApGrhJgClOX4LZLK1Bb7A0kF1iUhwwBe-ohuU%3D) for the week—like this is all some sort of joke. I am disgusted by our lack of leadership, and I am outraged that we aren’t going to hunker down in that Capitol building to work through our differences and deliver the results we all promised the American people. But let’s get one thing straight: Folks at home repeatedly ask me and my colleagues in Washington to stop spending money. We are $33 TRILLION in the hole. That number is difficult to come to grips with because you don’t even have enough dadgum hours in your _life_ to count to it. House Republicans just crunched the numbers to give us a[ blueprint](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0d504e4a97642a6b5826452753b79fe&_e=A-2t---pKNVYLFq8ifK69HhOmm8JtcotGTZyb9tNz9OaNQVNPxeklTG-sC2Bc5o94uzQgFkAa1lgExMEqz9G4-c1u96MqnCwsWklv6mpp-0YSRdi5BNRMmfedvDGZ5m7Eivq_8xs64GuRA5oN4JkrcK1Dmzn-gJKiS_gWIVp6SyhGLhFb8e8NgNbN6g6GGJbg5SK88Epz305iB4CUFDhfmPa_vI4yLt8yb7tO7_9gIKZ85e3lPqU-5PPoEjcKRhSA3_yEU7FLs2UNYjfqr8m8Q%3D%3D) that promises to balance the budget over the next 10 years. It has steep cuts because that is what’s required in this catastrophic mess, and it’s exactly where we need to go. Our current situation is unsustainable, and our country will collapse if we continue spending money like there’s no tomorrow. For that reason, I’m a “no” on any [continuing resolution](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=d0d504e4a97642a6b5826452753b79fe&_e=A-2t---pKNVYLFq8ifK69CR8Uu-ZmGfZdPiYzW_DR3Tv53ZN1k35CyCgpxugJ_iN7pXunpu-ukwYaNf2cGMJLg1ZxkgPR4qDvcHjFWduMmxIUXLKgeN1KH69QU6fOfObK5rMsSbYovtTiN2s8wBnA_AANnX071DpldTYbmYFESc48fTNa7ws45w0ll8b56JNsmiMv09SpwrGGd4CiT153q8L7Ku6lCfo1-DoNf-0zjAhflq0mjHFohgC6cTS_oQHg-9hbMFZKUMdA0BSfJQ3vt01fkt9c7YL1KcrTFlBP82viUHyVhe6xGEWZKQnf1Bw), which is basically a Band-Aid on a bullet hole. Let’s balance the budget and do right by the folks who sent us here. There’s no sense in kicking the can down the road with a quick fix that doesn’t get to the root of the problem: a total lack of responsibility in government spending. Americans are already working overtime to make up for the unsustainable pressure of inflation. Is this really what we want to pass on to our children? An inherited future of debt and uncertainty? Washington is in for a day of reckoning, and I pray we won’t be known as the generation that mortgaged our children’s future with fiscal insanity.
---
| | |
---

clean_body: | ~ Peter, this is a massive win for our youth-led movement to end gun violence across the country. Alongside young activists, organizers, and leaders, I’m proud to have fought for the creation of a federal office of gun violence prevention. Ending gun violence has been at the forefront of my campaign. It’s what called me to action – both as the National Organizing Director for March for our Lives and as the first of my generation to be elected to Congress. Our generation has been demanding action. And today, we have real, tangible progress in this fight. Not incremental progress, but a massive push forward. This is just the beginning. But I know the NRA and gun lobby are plotting revenge against our movement. We need to be prepared, so I’m setting out to raise $25,000 over the next 24 hours to keep me in the fight to end gun violence. | | | | ~~ | ~~ ~ Peter, they said a young organizer wouldn’t stand a chance against the gun lobby and the NRA-bought Republicans in Congress. And when I introduced my first bill in Congress to establish a federal office of gun violence prevention, Republicans thought they succeeded in blocking it. But we never gave up. And now, the Biden Administration is taking action. Our collective power made this happen. This is proof that our youth-powered movement is unstoppable. And we’re just getting started. So today, we celebrate this win in the fight to end gun violence. Tomorrow, we keep fighting. We keep organizing. We keep making noise. But it’s going to be an uphill battle against major forces that will stop at nothing to crush our progress. | | Friend, My name is Clara Gaitan, and I was so proud of my son Alex when he graduated from the police academy. But our dream of Alex serving as a police officer has become our family’s nightmare. **_Alex is facing 99 years in prison for catching a dangerous criminal!_** As a mother, I’m beside myself. You won’t believe how this miscarriage of justice came about. Back in March 2021, Alex was dispatched for an unknown urgent call for service. When Alex arrived at the address, he recognized he’d been there before on previous calls. The first time Alex had been there, he had to fight an inhumanly strong young man who was a drug user. Even with two other officers, it was nearly impossible to subdue the suspect. Only a non-lethal Taser worked, but not before the suspect injured an officer. However, on this day, **THREE** other officers had been dispatched to the scene, so they had a better chance of subduing the suspect. When Alex caught up with his fellow officers, he saw all three officers on the ground, struggling to bring the suspect under control. Alex told him to stop resisting, then grabbed his upper torso and put him on the ground. **Even on the ground with****FOUR AGAINST ONE****, the suspect had inhuman strength, as if he were on drugs.** Alex knew the suspect’s pain tolerance was so high that fist strikes would not work and could injure Alex. So Alex followed his training and used his police-issued baton to get the suspect to comply and lie fully on the ground. While on the ground, the suspect continued to resist the officers and their attempts to get him in handcuffs. So Alex decided to use his non-lethal Taser to get the suspect’s compliance. The Taser deployment worked, and the suspect stopped resisting the police officers. The danger was over, and Alex would come home that night. The possibility of your loved one not surviving their shift is a reality that every police family lives with, especially today when criminals are willing to fight officers. So we thought that was the end of it... **_but we were wrong._** Almost two years later, the local anti-cop, socialist District Attorney dropped a bombshell and indicted Alex for aggravated assault... ...even though it was the suspect who resisted arrest and decided it was a good idea to fight four police officers. Alex could be imprisoned for up to **99 years** if convicted. **_That’s outrageous!_** The good news is Alex has the moral support of his department, his Chief of Police, and hundreds of his Brothers and Sisters in Blue across the country. But, Friend, as you well know, cops don’t get paid a ton for the sacrifices they make and the dangers they put themselves in to keep us all safe. As a result of these attacks on my son, we’re facing a mountain of legal bills that could bury us — and send Alex to prison for up to 99 years! So when Jim Fotis and the National Center for Police Defense (NCPD), a 501(c)3 non-profit charity, offered to help us, it was like God was answering our prayers.

| Peter Did you vote early today? If not, don't worry. **Early voting will be available every weekday now through election day, excluding Monday, November 6th. ** Please, consider casting your ballot securely, in person at your registrar's office or other early voting location. I voted today at the Orange County Registrar's Office!
---
| | |
---
| If you are unsure where to cast your ballot, you can visit [secureyourvotevirginia.com/early](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecureyourvotevirginia.com%2Fearly/1/0100018abee11f48-5755d231-34d5-4541-a77e-38255438b4b8-000000/yMN4xvD1kZ_Sofx3F6169xWvus0=340) to find your polling place. Republican candidates and elected officials across Virginia are encouraging voters to show up and cast their vote early, because _this is our path to victory in November_. We need **every single conservative voter** to show up this election cycle in order to hold the House and take back the Senate, and voting early ensures a few things:
1. **Once you have voted, your name is struck from the registrar's list.** If someone comes behind you to try to steal your vote once you have cast your ballot, they will not be able to.
2. **Accidents happen!** Tires go flat, shifts run long, people get sick. Better to cast your ballot now than risk a mishap on election day.
3. Voting early frees you up to _volunteer on election day_ , helping to educate undecided voters on why we stand behind our conservative principles and how we can work to improve our beautiful Commonwealth.
4. _If you vote early, that helps save Republican candidates' advertising dollars!_ Once your ballot is cast and your name is struck from the list, candidates will be able to target their advertising to others who have not yet made it to the polls.

---
| | |
---
| If you have any questions, please reach out to my office at **(540) 645-8440** or **District17@Senate.Virginia.gov**. Thank you for your continued support, and God bless! Yours in service,
---

| | **Dear Friend, ** National Public Lands Day is tomorrow. **But wolves in the Yellowstone area are being slaughtered mercilessly.** And private interests like trophy hunters and Big Polluters are making matters worse. They’re teaming up to push against protections for these helpless canines. All for the sake of profit. We won’t stand by and watch them win. **That's why we've set an ambitious goal of $60,000 for National Public Lands Day. Because you've been such an essential supporter, we created a custom donation link you can use to be the FIRST to contribute. So please, rush your donation today! Here's your link: ** | [SPECIAL ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2006601?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This National Public Lands Day, there’s never been a better time to stand up for vulnerable species like wolves and the planet. But why should we protect them? Well, wolves are keystone species. They help keep elk and deer populations in check, allowing other plant and animal species to thrive. What’s more, the remains of their kills redistribute nutrients and feed scavengers. They play a vital role in our wild spaces like Yellowstone, **yet they're being hunted relentlessly. **
If trophy hunters manage to wipe out wolves, that would leave their lands defenseless. Big Polluters would be able to swoop in and use the land for their own profit. That means mining, logging, factory farming, and other planet-harming practices. Once these habitats are destroyed, **_wolves will stand no chance at recovering._ All so greedy interests can get their payday. **
That’s why our National Public Lands Day goal means so much to our vulnerable wolves, the public lands they roam, and our planet. I know you recognize how high the stakes are. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today to be part of this select group for early access.
**Can you rush a $27 donation right now for National Public Lands Day and help protect wolves, our public lands, and our planet? **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2006602?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

---
**A mere 6,000 wolves occupy less than 10% of their historic range in the lower 48 states. And with the recent slaughter of 25 Yellowstone wolves, only 89 remain in the national park. **
It's not an accident. Trophy hunters and Big Polluters are benefiting from the lack of Endangered Species Act protections for these wolves. But the ESA doesn’t just protect wolves. It’s a vital piece of legislation that stands between a healthy planet and rampant pollution. Without the ESA, countless communities would suffer the impacts of unchecked mining, fracking, and drilling.
We need to stop this before it's too late.
Friends of the Earth members like you are fueling the fight to protect vulnerable species like wolves and the public lands they roam -- all in service of our planet.
_**We can't afford to lose the fight. But we can't win without you.** _
**Iconic wolves, precious public lands, and our planet need your help before it's too late. Donate $27 to Friends of the Earth this National Public Lands Day. **

This is a watershed moment in the fight to save wolves, the public lands they call home, and our planet. CNN recently called Texas’ Senate seat one of the most likely to flip blue in 2024 – meaning Ted Cruz’s days as a U.S. Senator could be numbered. And perhaps most shocking of all, I’ve seen Cruz act as one of the most ardent obstructionists of gun safety reform in Congress – even as his own state of Texas suffers from an epidemic of gun violence. Texas and America deserve better – and fortunately, there’s hope in his Democratic challenger Rep. Colin Allred. Colin is a fourth-generation Texan and a former college and NFL athlete who went on to become a civil rights attorney. Importantly, Colin is already battle tested: He flipped a House district that had previously been red for 11 terms! Given that Cruz won by less than 3 points in 2018, with a candidate like Colin in the race, we have a real shot to flip this seat blue. **But Ted Cruz is sitting on a giant campaign war chest, which means the only way Colin can defeat him is with an outpouring of grassroots donations. Former President Donald Trump [is skipping](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=fab5921aec&e=0be619cbaa) the next Republican Presidential Debate in California to go speak to the auto workers union in Michigan. But if Trump is out, **NO ONE** on that debate stage will be talking about an America First policy agenda. That’s why it’s so important that I qualify for the presidential debate. We’ve got a country to save. That means defeating Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. We can’t do that with candidates who are beholden to special interests and the Washington establishment. We need someone who will fight for the hardworking men and women who make this country great. [There’s no more important time to fight back than now. **So I’m asking you, give what you can, and TOGETHER, we can make sure that WE THE PEOPLE are represented on that stage next week.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=eb07b3c1e6&e=0be619cbaa) I’m an independent conservative. I will always put America First, and I understand better than anyone what’s at stake. If we lose, the Democrats will double down on the same disastrous policies that ruined my home state of California. America simply can’t afford another four years of disastrous Democratic rule. It’s time to break down the political silos that have kept Americans from understanding each other. We need to reunite around common principles that have long made our country the envy of the world: individual liberty, economic freedom, energy independence, and strong national security. We need policies that put the people of this country first - ahead of special interests, woke corporations, foreign governments, and illegal immigration. [**That begins with a real debate. Will you donate what you can TODAY so I can participate in next week’s debate, ensuring America First policies are represented? But if Trump is out, NO ONE on that debate stage will be talking about an America First policy agenda. That’s why it’s so important that I qualify for the presidential debate. We’ve got a country to save. That means defeating Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. We can’t do that with candidates who are beholden to special interests and the Washington establishment. We need someone who will fight for the hardworking men and women who make this country great. I’m an independent conservative. I will always put America First, and I understand better than anyone what’s at stake. If we lose, the Democrats will double down on the same disastrous policies that ruined my home state of California. America simply can’t afford another four years of disastrous Democratic rule. It’s time to break down the political silos that have kept Americans from understanding each other. We need to reunite around common principles that have long made our country the envy of the world: individual liberty, economic freedom, energy independence, and strong national security. We need policies that put the people of this country first - ahead of special interests, woke corporations, foreign governments, and illegal immigration. ** Campaign News and Views: Recap Edition
------------------------------------------------------------
If you missed any of Ryan's media appearances, here's a recap of the past two weeks. Watch him give speeches, talk on podcasts, and share his message of freedom and unity with America. Check out the nine events below:

** Events
------------------------------------------------------------

** New England College Town Hall
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan held a fantastic town hall meeting in New Hampshire. He talked to many college students about his plans to heal the rift in our nation. Watch on C-SPAN here (https://www.c-span.org/video/?530446-1/ryan-binkley-speaks-england-college-town-hall&mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

** Iowa Faith & Freedom Coalition Speech
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan spoke at the Iowa Faith & Freedom Coalition's Presidential Town Hall. He talked about the instrumental role of faith and family in his life, the importance of supporting Israel, and many other issues. Ryan speaks from 2:28:40 to 2:37:30. Watch here (https://www.ffcoalition.com/livestream-iowa-ffc-presidential-town-hall/?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Blackhawk County Lincoln Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan spoke with more Iowans at the Blackhawk County Lincoln Dinner about his plans to solve our nation's most challenging problems.
Watch here (https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/kssj2nbwdjjk42qxrtdla/RB-Blackhawk-County-Linclon-Dinner-Speech.mp4?rlkey=gjrzonye7ci6p4nbb6gp5feqb&dl=0&mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Articles
------------------------------------------------------------

** TickerNews Talk
------------------------------------------------------------

In this TickerNews article, Ryan talks about his campaign's origins, his plans for the nation, and how the Republicans need a new playbook to win in 2024. Read here (https://tickernews.co/who-is-u-s-presidential-candidate-ryan-binkley/?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Ryan Defends School Chaplains in Texas
------------------------------------------------------------

The Christian Post interviewed Ryan about his support for hiring chaplains in Texas schools. He believes it will "provide better counseling for our younger generation." Read here (https://www.christianpost.com/news/pastor-defends-texas-law-allowing-schools-to-hire-chaplains.html?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Protecting the Heartland
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan opposes the Iowa CO2 pipelines, which threaten property rights and could damage farmland if they rupture. Watch the online Zoom event here (https://zoom.us/rec/play/ERokADzcBOeg1tZbV-3gx9QHO4DGq4kS4p2gMFXYjXvjti-8kMtA8w_G7AF3ddbQFvJyOo0f-dNvGqE3.fMQYlAB5_2o0ypxh?canPlayFromShare=true&from=share_recording_detail&continueMode=true&componentName=rec-play&originRequestUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzoom.us%2Frec%2Fshare%2Ft1A5pPf5Qm3n832tKx7B4cFuQL54o9NO44tvBCJxe8ngDA36Z1KBNzLhILJK7Hls.gYdw-hgSwDxvQFNU&mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID) , which was covered in this article (https://kchanews.com/2023/09/12/presidential-hopeful-binkley-takes-stand-against-carbon-pipelines/?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

** Podcasts and Radio
------------------------------------------------------------

** Talk with Jaco Booyens
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan Binkley discusses immigration with Jaco Booyens, a Christian abolitionist and a leader in the fight against sex trafficking. Watch here (https://www.instagram.com/p/CxLo0vluCl_/?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Good Morning NH
------------------------------------------------------------

On Good Morning New Hampshire, Ryan answers the question of why he's running for president and talks with host Jack Heath. Listen here (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JvlU1QNInpYsOPceYhdR7bxFYG7NNZF6/view?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Lone Star Radio
------------------------------------------------------------

Ryan joins Dick Schissler on Lone Star, where they discuss the distortion of media and the dangers of a digital dollar. Watch here (https://irlonestar.com/2023/09/22/92223mwls/?mc_cid=6681b3535c&mc_eid=UNIQID)

| | Friend, My name is Clara Gaitan, and I was so proud of my son Alex when he graduated from the police academy. But our dream of Alex serving as a police officer has become our family’s nightmare. **_Alex is facing 99 years in prison for catching a dangerous criminal!_** As a mother, I’m beside myself. You won’t believe how this miscarriage of justice came about. Back in March 2021, Alex was dispatched for an unknown urgent call for service. When Alex arrived at the address, he recognized he’d been there before on previous calls. The first time Alex had been there, he had to fight an inhumanly strong young man who was a drug user. Even with two other officers, it was nearly impossible to subdue the suspect. Only a non-lethal Taser worked, but not before the suspect injured an officer. However, on this day, **THREE** other officers had been dispatched to the scene, so they had a better chance of subduing the suspect. When Alex caught up with his fellow officers, he saw all three officers on the ground, struggling to bring the suspect under control. name: Team AOC
subject: Student loan payments are due again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Some insights into a complicated process.
#
Student loan payments are starting on October 1st.
While we disagree with lifting the student loan payment pause, we do think it’s important that people have the facts. Tons of people have been asking about where to even start after 3 years of suspended payments.
So **Alexandria put together a multi-video guide to walk you through all things student loans** : from how to make a payment, to how to report your servicer if they’re violating the new laws, how to apply to new programs that can reduce (or even eliminate) your student loan payment, and more. She also discusses where we are in the larger fight for debt cancellation — because we’re not giving up.
We’ll go through the important highlights in this email, but [you can watch the videos on YouTube here](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/21021?utm_source=em20230922-5030&t=1&akid=5030%2E2526796%2EMLJKUQ) (or if you’re on TikTok, check out the series [here](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/21022?utm_source=em20230922-5030&t=2&akid=5030%2E2526796%2EMLJKUQ)) →
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/21021?utm_source=em20230922-5030&t=3&akid=5030%2E2526796%2EMLJKUQ)
First of all: if you can help it, **do not wait until the night before your payment is due to start this process.** With millions of people all restarting their payments at once, customer service lines for lenders are going to be completely overwhelmed.
There are also some new repayment programs you should know about. Under SAVE, single borrowers on an income of $15/hour or less won’t have to make any payments at all, nor will married borrowers in a household of 4 making less than $60K/year. And even if you make more, **the SAVE program is likely to cut your monthly payments in half.** Learn more at studentaid.gov/SAVE.
It’s also important to note that, for the next 12 months, **no one’s credit will be hurt if they can’t afford to pay, or make a late or partial payment** — but while you won’t get a ding on your credit, **interest will still accrue.**
4 in 10 people will also have a different loan servicer than they did before COVID — and you may not even realize that your debt was sold. So once you are ready to make your first payment, **double check who you actually have to make a payment to.**
And regardless of whether or not your lender has changed, **update your contact info on studentaid.gov and your servicers’ website.** Even if your lender can’t contact you, that won’t stop them from charging you interest.
We hope these tips will be helpful as you navigate the process of repayment. And of course, the fight for student loan cancellation and higher education reform is not over. **No one should have to take on a lifetime of debt in order to get a degree.**
Yours in service,
Team AOC

clean_body: Some insights into a complicated process. Student loan payments are starting on October 1st. While we disagree with lifting the student loan payment pause, we do think it’s important that people have the facts. Tons of people have been asking about where to even start after 3 years of suspended payments. So Alexandria put together a multi-video guide to walk you through all things student loans : from how to make a payment, to how to report your servicer if they’re violating the new laws, how to apply to new programs that can reduce (or even eliminate) your student loan payment, and more. She also discusses where we are in the larger fight for debt cancellation — because we’re not giving up. We’ll go through the important highlights in this email, but (or if you’re on TikTok, check out the series ) → First of all: if you can help it, do not wait until the night before your payment is due to start this process. With millions of people all restarting their payments at once, customer service lines for lenders are going to be completely overwhelmed. There are also some new repayment programs you should know about. Under SAVE, single borrowers on an income of $15/hour or less won’t have to make any payments at all, nor will married borrowers in a household of 4 making less than $60K/year. And even if you make more, the SAVE program is likely to cut your monthly payments in half. Learn more at studentaid.gov/SAVE. It’s also important to note that, for the next 12 months, no one’s credit will be hurt if they can’t afford to pay, or make a late or partial payment — but while you won’t get a ding on your credit, interest will still accrue. 4 in 10 people will also have a different loan servicer than they did before COVID — and you may not even realize that your debt was sold. So once you are ready to make your first payment, double check who you actually have to make a payment to. And regardless of whether or not your lender has changed, update your contact info on studentaid.gov and your servicers’ website. Even if your lender can’t contact you, that won’t stop them from charging you interest. We hope these tips will be helpful as you navigate the process of repayment. And of course, the fight for student loan cancellation and higher education reform is not over. No one should have to take on a lifetime of debt in order to get a degree. Yours in service, Team AOC | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com
